kikuyu: Nĩngwenda mũmenye atĩ ndireeka ũndũ ũyũ nĩ ũndũ wanyu, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga. Iguai thoni, na mũnyararithio nĩ ũndũ wa mĩtugo yanyu, inyuĩ andũ a nyũmba ya Isiraeli!
english: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ, rũciinĩ tene, andũ acio na Isaaka makĩĩhĩtanĩra mwĩhĩtwa mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ. Isaaka agĩcooka akĩmoimagaria, magĩĩthiĩra, makĩmũtiga na thayũ.
english: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩtwatũma Judasi na Sila nĩgeetha makindĩre ũhoro ũyũ tũramwandĩkĩra na ciugo cia tũnua twao.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

kikuyu: Nake Ayubu akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Wee ũraaria ta mũndũ-wa-nja mũkĩĩgu. Kaĩ turĩkĩamũkagĩra o maũndũ mega kuuma kũrĩ Ngai, na tũtiamũkĩre mathĩĩna?” Thĩinĩ wa maũndũ macio mothe-rĩ, Ayubu ndaigana kwĩhia thĩinĩ wa mĩario yake.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire matawa mũgwanja maguo, o ũndũ ũmwe na magathĩ ma gũtinia ndaambĩ, na thaani cia mũrarĩ wa ndaambĩ, cia thahabu therie.
english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũrĩa maaitĩrĩirio maguta, Jehova nĩathanire atĩ andũ a Isiraeli mamaheage nyama icio hĩndĩ ciothe ituĩke rwĩga rwao nginya njiarwa iria igooka.
english: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ igai thĩinĩ wa Isiraeli rĩkoima mũhĩrĩga ũmwe rĩtuĩke rĩa mũhĩrĩga ũngĩ, nĩgũkorwo Mũisiraeli o wothe nĩagatũũria gĩthaka kĩa mũhĩrĩga kĩrĩa maagaire kuuma kũrĩ maithe mao ma tene.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

kikuyu: Githĩ waganu waku ti mũnene? Mehia maku-rĩ, makĩrĩ mũthia?
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩĩra Toma atĩrĩ, “Toonyia kĩara gĩaku haha; rora moko makwa. Tambũrũkia guoko gwaku ũgũikie mbaru-inĩ ciakwa. Tiga kũgĩa na nganja, ĩtĩkia.”
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa wĩtĩkĩrĩte ũira ũcio nĩahũũrĩte mũhũũri atĩ Ngai nĩ wa ma.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩwe ndaaragia ũhoro wake rĩrĩa ndoigire atĩrĩ, ‘Mũndũ ũrĩa ũgũũka thuutha wakwa nĩ mũnene kũrĩ niĩ tondũ we aarĩ kuo mbere yakwa.’
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

kikuyu: Mũhari wa tũnyũmba twa mwena ũrĩa wariganĩtie na nja ya nyumĩrĩra warĩ wa ũraihu wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano, naguo mũhari ũrĩa wakuhĩrĩirie handũ-harĩa-hatheru warĩ wa ũraihu wa mĩkono igana.
english: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

kikuyu: na akĩrũgama thuutha wake, o hau magũrũ-inĩ make, akĩrĩraga, na akĩambĩrĩria kũmũihũgia nyarĩrĩ na maithori make. Agĩcooka akĩmũgiria nyarĩrĩ na njuĩrĩ yake, agĩcimumunya, na agĩciitĩrĩria maguta manungi wega.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩtoonyia mĩtĩ ĩyo mĩraaya mĩrĩnga-inĩ ĩyo yarĩ mĩena-inĩ ya ithandũkũ ĩrĩ ya kũrĩkuua.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

kikuyu: Maarĩrĩrie, na ũmatuĩre ciira na kĩhooto; rũĩrĩra kĩhooto kĩa arĩa athĩĩni na arĩa abatari.”
english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, kwarĩ ta thaa thita cia mũthenya, naguo bũrũri wothe ũkĩgĩa nduma nginya thaa kenda,
english: It was now about the sixth hour,‡ and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.§

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, wee igũrũ, ta thikĩrĩria! Nawe thĩ ta igua! Nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩarĩtie akoiga atĩrĩ: “Niĩ heete ciana irio, ngacirera igakũra, no cio ikaanemera.
english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh† has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.

kikuyu: mũgoocei na tũhembe mũkĩrũgarũgaga, mũmũgooce na inanda cia nga mũkĩhuhaga mĩtũrirũ,
english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũcio nĩũkoneka ta ũtarĩ wa ma kũrĩ andũ arĩa mehĩtĩte atĩ nĩmarĩmwathĩkagĩra, nowe nĩakamaririkania mahĩtia mao, acooke amanyiite mĩgwate.
english: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Shaitani agĩtoonya thĩinĩ wa Judasi ũrĩa Mũisikariota, ũmwe wa arutwo arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

kikuyu: O na gũtuĩka nĩ niĩ ndatũmire aiyũrie guoya bũrũri-inĩ wa arĩa marĩ muoyo-rĩ, Firaũni hamwe na kĩrĩndĩ gĩake gĩothe nĩmagakomio hamwe na arĩa matarĩ aruu, hamwe na arĩa maanooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.”
english: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ thũ ĩkaamwĩtia igooti. gũtirĩ mũndũ mwaganu ũkaamũhinyĩrĩria.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

kikuyu: Nao Ayahudi makĩgega, makĩũrania atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũyũ aamenyeire maũndũ maya kũ, na ndath- omete?”
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

kikuyu: Kĩrĩ kũu icua-inĩ, kĩna ruo rũnene, gĩgĩtiira maitho, gĩkĩona Iburahĩmu arĩ haraaya, na Lazaro arĩ hau nake.
english: In Hades,† he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

kikuyu: na Mishima, na Duma, na Masa, na Hadadi, na Tema,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

kikuyu: Maatoonyire bũrũri ũcio makĩwĩgwatĩra ũgĩtuĩka wao, no rĩrĩ, matiigana gũgwathĩkĩra kana kũrũmĩrĩra mawatho maku; matiekire maũndũ marĩa wamaathĩte meke. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ũkĩmarehithĩria mwanangĩko ũyũ ũmakorete.
english: They came in and possessed it, but they didn’t obey your voice and didn’t walk in your law. They have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do. Therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them.

kikuyu: Nao makĩmũruma, makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wee ũrĩ mũrutwo wa mũndũ ũyũ! Ithuĩ tũrĩ arutwo a Musa!
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo mũigana wa andũ arĩa Nebukadinezaru aatahire akĩmatwara bũrũri ũngĩ: mwaka-inĩ wa mũgwanja aatahire Ayahudi 3,023;
english: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa mathekagĩrĩra makiugaga atĩrĩ, “Haiya! Haiya!” marocooka na thuutha maconokete.
english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Ũũgĩ nĩũgakũhonokia kuuma harĩ mũtumia ũrĩa mũtharia, ũkũhonokie harĩ ngʼenyũ ya mũtumia na ciugo ciake cia kũheenereria andũ,
english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

kikuyu: Rīrīa mūrimū wa kīhuruto woka na ūritū mūnene, ngūkū īkuaga thīinī wa thikū ithano nginya mūgwanja.
english: In the acute type, death occurs in five to seven days.

kikuyu: Agūri arīa matwaraga makorobia mabūrūri-inīma rūraya magūraga o ikorobia rīa Hass kuuma shiringi ikūmi nginya ikūmi na mūgwanja narīo rīa Fuerte shiringi ithatū.
english: Avocado exporters in Kenya buy Hass avocado at Sh10-Sh17 per fruit compared to Sh3 for Fuerte;

kikuyu: Aca, hatirī bata
english: No, it is not essential.

kikuyu: Mathaithana makwa marokinya harĩwe; ndeithũra kũringana na kĩĩranĩro gĩaku.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

kikuyu: Ndacookagia rĩrĩa andũ maakaya nĩ ũndũ wa mwĩtũũgĩrio wa andũ arĩa aaganu.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

kikuyu: nĩmũgookĩrĩra mũthamaki wa Babuloni na kĩnyũrũri, mũmwĩre atĩrĩ: Kaĩ mũhinyanĩrĩria nĩakinyĩte mũthia-ĩ! Kaĩ marakara make mahiũ nĩmathirĩte-ĩ!
english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũrĩ wathiĩ igũrũ tiga ũrĩa woimire igũrũ, na nĩwe Mũrũ wa Mũndũ.”
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Ngoro yakwa nĩnditũhĩre ĩrĩ thĩinĩ wakwa; nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngũkũririkana ndĩ bũrũri wa Jorodani, o kũu irĩma-inĩ cia Herimoni,* kuuma Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Mizari.
english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, andũ magĩthiĩ o na mbere kũrutĩra magongona kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru, no mamarutagĩra Jehova Ngai wao o we wiki.
english: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to Yahweh their God.

kikuyu: Mambarita magīrīire kūrathwo na mūhianīre wa v, nīguo maaī magaikūrūka wega, magitwo na mabati, mīnyore kana nyeki.
english: The roof should be v-shaped (for easy flow of rainwater) made of iron sheets, plastic sheets with papyrus or grass thatched.

kikuyu: Agĩthiĩ na mbere, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũmũthĩ rĩrĩa nginyire gĩthima-inĩ kĩa maaĩ, njugire atĩrĩ, ‘Wee Jehova Ngai wa Iburahĩmu mwathi wakwa, ũngĩenda, ndagũthaitha, gaacĩrithia rũgendo rũrũ njũkĩte.
english: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Ahazia mũrũ wa Ahabu akĩĩra Jehoshafatu atĩrĩ, “Ĩtĩkĩria andũ akwa matherere hamwe na andũ aku,” nowe Jehoshafatu akĩrega.
english: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakooya thakame ĩmwe ya maruta ma mehia amĩhake itingĩ-inĩ cia mĩrango ya hekarũ, na amĩhake koine ciothe inya cia metha ya kĩgongona, o na amĩhake itingĩ-inĩ cia itoonyero rĩa nja ya na thĩinĩ.
english: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.

kikuyu: Thoguo angĩoigire atĩrĩ, ‘Mbũri iria irĩ maara nĩcio mũcaara waku,’ hĩndĩ ĩyo mahiũ mothe magaciara tũũri tũrĩ na maara; na angĩoigire atĩrĩ, ‘Iria irĩ marooro nĩcio mũcaara waku,’ namo mahiũ magaciara tũũri tũrĩ na marooro.
english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.

kikuyu: Matukũ-inĩ ma kũrigĩrĩria kĩrĩma kĩa hekarũ ya Jehova nĩgĩkahaandwo kĩrĩ kĩo kĩnene gatagatĩ ka irĩma iria ingĩ; nĩgĩkambarario igũrũ rĩa tũrĩma tũrĩa tũngĩ, nao andũ a ndũrĩrĩ nĩkuo magaathiiaga.
english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

kikuyu: Tūkīrora matūra ma kūrīma ma būrūri wa Kenya, mīthemba ya maembe nī īrī:
english: Using Kenya’s agro-ecological zoning, there are two major mango categories;

kikuyu: Nīkūheaga mukimo mwega wīna mūtutu rĩrĩa ciarĩkia kũrugwo.
english: This gives you a flourily or fluffy smooth mash when they are cooked.

kikuyu: Angīkorūo gūtirīnjīra īngī, hūthīra dawa ya kūniina mītarakwa (chemical ya kūūraga kana kūniina mītarakwa) mbere ya kūhanda kana hīndīo īyo.
english: If no other alternatives, use a nematicide (nematode killing or disabling chemical) before or simultaneously at planting.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio athigaani acio makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Mũrutani, nĩtũũĩ wee waragia na ũkarutana maũndũ marĩa magĩrĩire, na atĩ ndũtĩagĩra andũ maũthĩ, no wee ũrutanaga ũhoro wa Ngai na ma, ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

kikuyu: na ndegwa igĩrĩ, na ndũrũme ithano, na thenge ithano, na tũtũrũme tũtano twa mwaka ũmwe, irutwo irĩ igongona rĩa ũiguano. Ici nĩcio indo iria ciarutirwo nĩ Ahira mũrũ wa Enani.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

kikuyu: o we ũkũhũũnagia na maũndũ mega nĩgeetha waanake waku werũhagio o ta wa nderi.*
english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

kikuyu: Hwaĩ-inĩ ũcio gũgĩũka tũnyoni tũrĩa twĩtagwo tũmakia-arũme tũkĩiyũra kambĩ ciao. Naguo rũciinĩ kwarĩ ime rĩathiũrũrũkĩirie kambĩ ciao.
english: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

kikuyu: Nĩarehire kũu hekarũ ya Jehova betha, na thahabu, na indo iria ciothe we mwene hamwe na ithe maamũrĩte.
english: He brought into Yahweh’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.

kikuyu: Ihinda rĩa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtatũ, kuuma mwaka-inĩ wa ikũmi na ĩtatũ wa ũthamaki wa Josia mũrũ wa Amoni mũthamaki wa Juda, nginya ũmũthĩ, ndũmĩrĩri cia Jehova itũire inginyagĩrĩra, na niĩ ngamũhe ũhoro wacio kaingĩ kaingĩ, no mũtithikĩrĩirie.*
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

kikuyu: Nĩndaririe rĩmwe, no ndirĩ na macookio; o na ngĩaria rĩa keerĩ, no ndirĩ na ũndũ ũngĩ nguuga.”
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jusufu ookire mũciĩ-rĩ, makĩmũhe iheo iria maarehete kũu nyũmba-inĩ, na makĩinamĩrĩra, magĩturumithia mothiũ mao thĩ mbere yake.
english: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.

kikuyu: īka imwe ībatiī kūhandwo itina cigana cia kahūa?
english: How many coffee trees can be planted in an īka?

kikuyu: Thondeka mbaũ ithathatũ cia mwena wa na thuutha, nĩguo mwena wa mũthia wa ithũĩro wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

kikuyu: Ĩ kũngĩkorwo amwe ao nĩmagire kwĩhokeka, kwaga kwĩhokeka kwao, nĩkũngĩatũmire Ngai aage gũtuĩka mwĩhokeku?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Ngai akĩmũhingũra maitho, nake akĩona gĩthima kĩa maaĩ. Agĩthiĩ ho, akĩiyũria rũũa maaĩ, na akĩhe kĩmwana kĩu kĩnyue.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

kikuyu: Andũ a Edomu nĩmookĩte rĩngĩ na magatharĩkĩra Juda, na magakuua mĩgwate,
english: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.

kikuyu: Nayo nyũngũ ya rĩũmba ĩrĩa ĩkaaruga nyama icio no nginya yũragwo; no ingĩkaarugwo na nyũngũ ya gĩcango-rĩ, nyũngũ ĩyo nĩĩgakumuthwo, ĩcooke ĩkamũrwo na maaĩ.
english: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

kikuyu: Nĩgeetha atherie nyũmba ĩyo, nĩakoya nyoni igĩrĩ, na kamũtĩ ka mũtarakwa, na rũrigi rwa rangi wa gakarakũ, na mũthobi.
english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

kikuyu: No ngūrie marigū irīma- inī Kenya?
english: Can I grow bananas on sloping land in Kenya?

kikuyu: Anĩrĩrai mũine mũrĩ na gĩkeno, inyuĩ andũ a Zayuni, nĩgũkorwo Ũrĩa Mũtheru wa Isiraeli, o ũcio ũrĩ gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu, nĩ mũnene mũno.”
english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

kikuyu: Matunda ta Jack fruit na mababaī mahandagūo marigūinī magatūhe matunda
english: Fruit trees like jack fruit and papaw are established with the plantation as sources of fruit.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ndungata ĩyo ĩkĩruta thahabu, na mathaga ma betha na nguo, na ĩgĩcihe Rebeka; ĩgĩcooka ĩkĩhe Labani mũrũ wa nyina, o na nyina, iheo cia goro.
english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

kikuyu: Nĩmũriganĩirwo nĩ Ngai, Mũhonokia wanyu; nĩmwagĩte kũririkana Rwaro rũu rwa Ihiga, o rũu kĩĩgitĩro kĩanyu. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio o na mũngĩkahaanda mĩmera ĩrĩa mĩega mũno, na mũhaande mĩthabibũ ya kuuma kũndũ kũngĩ,
english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.

kikuyu: Ngĩmenya atĩ rĩathani o rĩu rĩarĩ rĩa gũtũma mũndũ atũũre muoyo-rĩ, norĩo rĩarehire gĩkuũ.
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

kikuyu: Ciugo cia kanua ka mũndũ nĩ ta ndia ndiku, no gĩthima kĩa ũũgĩ nĩ karũũĩ gatherũkaga.
english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

kikuyu: No mũndũ ahota kuuga atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo kũheenania gwakwa no kũingĩhie ũhoro-wa-ma wa Ngai, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio gũtũme riiri wake wongerereke-rĩ, niĩ ngĩtuagĩrwo ciira ta ndĩ mwĩhia nĩkĩ?”
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

kikuyu: Hihi ndariri cia ngūkū ndwaru imenyekaga atia?
english: How to monitor for signs of illness in chicken?

kikuyu: o andũ arĩa matũũraga maathirĩkagia o ũthiũ-inĩ wakwa, makarutagĩra magongona mĩgũnda-inĩ, na magacinagĩra ũbumba igongona-inĩ cia maturubarĩ;
english: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;

kikuyu: Ubatiī kūhanda mīembe īigana harī īka īmwe
english: How many mango trees can be planted in one īka?

kikuyu: Nao maakinya kuo, makĩmahoera nĩguo maamũkĩre Roho Mũtheru,
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Solomoni agĩũkĩra toro, akĩmenya atĩ kĩu kĩarĩ kĩroto. Agĩcooka Jerusalemu, agĩthiĩ mbere ya ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova, na akĩruta igongona rĩa njino na rĩa ngwatanĩro. Ningĩ akĩrugithĩria andũ othe a nyũmba ya mũthamaki iruga.
english: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.

kikuyu: “Rehaga indo iria njega cia maciaro ma mbere nyũmba-inĩ ya Jehova Ngai waku. “Ndũkanaruge koori na iria rĩa nyina.†
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Harĩ na rũhiũ rwa njora rwa gũũkĩrĩra andũ a Babuloni, rũũkĩrĩre arĩa matũũraga Babuloni, na rũũkĩrĩre anene na andũ arĩa ogĩ akuo!
english: “A sword is on the Chaldeans,” says Yahweh, “and on the inhabitants of Babylon, on her princes, and on her wise men.

kikuyu: Kuuma njiaro-inĩ cia Gadi: Arũme othe arĩa maakinyĩtie mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria, arĩa mangĩahotire gũthiĩ ita-inĩ, makĩandĩkwo o mũndũ o mũndũ na rĩĩtwa rĩake, kũringana na maandĩko ma mbarĩ ciao na nyũmba ciao.
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: mũndũ ũcio ndarĩ bata wa ‘gũtĩĩa ithe’ naguo. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũgagĩtua kiugo kĩa Ngai gĩa tũhũ nĩ ũndũ wa kĩrĩra kĩanyu.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

kikuyu: nao magĩthiĩ gatũũra kangĩ.

kikuyu: Maahaaraga nyeni cia mahuti ma cumbĩ kuuma ihinga-inĩ, na irio ciao ciarĩ mĩri ya mũtĩ wa kĩhaato.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

kikuyu: Musa akĩmũcookeria, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Tondũ andũ aya marokaga kũrĩ niĩ nĩguo mamenye wendi wa Ngai.
english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

kikuyu: Nīutambagio nī tūtambi ta njūkī harī kīro kīa njamba.
english: • Transmitted by insects including bees through the male bud

english: These materials should be applied at the base of the plants around the stool and around infected pseudostems.

kikuyu: “Rĩu niĩ nĩngũthondeka kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa na inyuĩ, na njiaro cianyu iria igooka thuutha wanyu,
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

kikuyu: Macio nĩmo maathani marĩa Jehova aaheire Musa Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩa Sinai makoniĩ andũ a Isiraeli.
english: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Wamenyithanirie itua rĩaku ũrĩ o kũu igũrũ, nayo thĩ ĩgĩĩtigĩra na ĩgĩkira ki,
english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũgaathiĩ bũrũri ũrĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu ekũmũhe, na mũkorwo mũwĩgwatĩire na mũgaatũũra kuo, na muuge atĩrĩ, “Rekei tũgĩe na mũthamaki witũ ta ndũrĩrĩ iria cio- the itũthiũrũrũkĩirie,”
english: When you have come to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

kikuyu: Iburahĩmu ndeerĩirwo kĩĩranĩro atĩ nĩagatuĩka mũgai wa thĩ hamwe na njiaro ciake nĩ ũndũ wa gwathĩkĩra watho, no nĩ ũndũ wa ũthingu ũrĩa uumanaga na wĩtĩkio.
english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

kikuyu: Ĩrutaga ndogo na maniũrũ taarĩ nyũngũ ĩratherũka ĩhagĩrĩtwo igũrũ rĩa mwaki wa ithanjĩ.
english: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

kikuyu: “Magongona macio manyu mũndutagĩra maingĩ-rĩ, nĩ ma kĩ kũrĩ niĩ?” Ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekũũria. “Nĩnjiganĩtwo nĩ magongona ma njino, na magongona ma ndũrũme, na maguta ma nyamũ noru; niĩ ndikenagĩra thakame ya ndegwa, na ya tũtũrũme, o na ya mbũri.
english: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

kikuyu: Thogora wa iria ūngīkorwo wīmūnene, nogūo baida īnenehaga.
english: If the milk price is high, this method may coincide with maximum profit.

kikuyu: Nake Paũlũ akĩmageithia na akĩmeera ũrĩa wothe Ngai eekĩire andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ agereire ũtungata-inĩ wake.
english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Ayubu ti niĩ ekwerekeirie ciugo ciake, na niĩ ndikũmũcookeria kũringana na mĩario yanyu.
english: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũndũ ũcio wehumbĩte nguo cia gatani, na akeoha indo cia wandĩki njohero, agĩcookia ndũmĩrĩri, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩnjĩkĩte o ta ũrĩa wathanire.”
english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”

kikuyu: “Ayubu aroiga atĩrĩ, ‘Niĩ ndihĩtĩtie, no Mũrungu nĩanjagithĩtie kĩhooto gĩakwa.
english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo mũthenya nĩmũkinyu wa kũniina andũ a Filisti othe, na wa kweheria matigari mothe ma andũ arĩa mangĩteithia Turo na Sidoni. Jehova arĩ hakuhĩ kwananga andũ a Filisti, acio maatigaire kuuma hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Kafitori.
english: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for Yahweh will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

kikuyu: Arutwo ake aingĩ maigua ũguo makiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũyũ nĩ ũrutani mũritũ mũno, nũũ ũngĩhota kũwĩtĩkĩra?”
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

kikuyu: Roho wake ũgakuhĩrĩria mbĩrĩra, na muoyo wake ũgakuhĩrĩria arĩa mareehage gĩkuũ.
english: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

kikuyu: na Ibineia mũrũ wa Jerohamu; Ela mũrũ wa Uzi, mũrũ wa Mikiri; na Meshulamu mũrũ wa Shefatia, mũrũ wa Reueli, mũrũ wa Ibinija.
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

kikuyu: Makĩiguana nake atĩ maake marikabu cia wonjoria. Nao maarĩkia gũciakĩra kũu Ezioni-Geberi,
english: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ũkĩgemio na thahabu na betha: nacio nguo ciaku ciarĩ cia gatani ĩrĩa njega, na itambaya cia goro, na nguo ngʼemie. Irio ciaku ciarĩ mũtu mũhinyu, na ũũkĩ, na maguta ma mũtamaiyũ. Wee nawe ũgĩthakara mũno na ũkĩambatĩrio ũgĩtuĩka mũthamaki-mũndũ-wa-nja.
english: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa mũthingu nĩahonokagio kuuma thĩĩna-inĩ, naguo ũgaacookerera ũrĩa mwaganu.
english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Rĩrĩa mũgaatoonya bũrũri ũcio ngũmũhe na mũgethe magetha maguo, nĩmũkarehere mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai kĩohe kĩa mbere kĩa ngano ĩrĩa mũkaagetha.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ngaatũma bũrũri wa Misiri ũkire ihooru, na njeherie kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩrĩ kũu bũrũri-inĩ, na hũũre arĩa othe matũũraga kuo-rĩ, hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.’
english: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that of which it was full, when I strike all those who dwell therein, then they will know that I am Yahweh.

kikuyu: Mahinda ma mbere Finehasi mũrũ wa Eleazaru nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra arangĩri a ihingo, nake Jehova aarĩ hamwe nake.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.

kikuyu: Ndũkanehũgũre mwena wa ũrĩo kana wa ũmotho ũtigane na rĩathani o na rĩmwe rĩa maya ndĩrakũhe ũmũthĩ, kana ũrũmagĩrĩre ngai ingĩ na ũcitungatagĩre.
english: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

kikuyu: “Atĩrĩrĩ, ĩno nĩyo ndungata yakwa, ĩrĩa ndiiragĩrĩra, ĩrĩa ndĩthuurĩire na nĩyo ĩkenagia ngoro yakwa; nĩngamĩitĩrĩria Roho wakwa nayo nĩĩkarehithĩria ndũrĩrĩ ciira wa kĩhooto.
english: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa aamenyire atĩ Jesũ aarĩ wa bũrũri ũrĩa wathanagwo nĩ Herode, akiuga atwarwo kũrĩ Herode, ũrĩa wakoretwo arĩ Jerusalemu ihinda-inĩ rĩu.
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

kikuyu: Jusufu agĩkĩigithia ngano nyingĩ mũno, o ta mũthanga wa iria-inĩ; yarĩ nyingĩ mũno, o nginya agĩtiga kũiga maandĩko ma mũigana wayo tondũ ndĩngĩathimĩkire.
english: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

kikuyu: Ũcooke ũgatumĩrĩre mĩhari ĩna ya tũhiga twa goro. Mũhari wa mbere hakorwo kahiga ka wakiki ũrĩa mũtune, na ka yakuti ĩrĩa ĩhaana ngoikoni, na ka baregethu;
english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

english: • Withering of flowers, wilting of leaves and premature ripening of fruits

english: The chickens are housed only in the evening either in the main house (enclosed baskets) with the household members, kitchen or small-structured chicken houses

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, ũthingu ũrĩa uumanaga na gwĩtĩkia uugaga atĩrĩ: “Ndũkaneyũrie na ngoro atĩrĩ, ‘Nũũ ũkwambata akinye igũrũ?’ ” (ũguo nĩ kuuga, agĩĩre Kristũ amũrehe gũkũ thĩ)

english: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says Yahweh.

english: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.

english: The cost can be higher or lower depending on several factors.

kikuyu: Thigari cia mũcaara iria irĩ kuo ihaana ta njaũ cia gĩcegũ. O nao nĩmakagarũrũka more marĩ hamwe, matikahota gwĩtiiria, nĩgũkorwo mũthenya wa mwanangĩko nĩũkamakorerera, na nĩrĩo ihinda rĩao rĩa kũherithio.
english: Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall, for they also are turned back. They have fled away together. They didn’t stand, for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.

kikuyu: Ta rĩrĩa mũndũ angĩthiĩ mũtitũ marĩ na mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake makoine ngũ, na akĩhiũria ithanwa ateme mũtĩ-rĩ, ithanwa rĩrũke, rĩrũũge, rĩringe mũndũ ũcio wa itũũra rĩake, rĩmũũrage. Mũndũ ũcio no orĩre itũũra rĩmwe rĩa macio nĩguo ahonokie muoyo wake.
english: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

kikuyu: Kũu thĩinĩ waku nĩ kũrĩ mũndũ wĩkaga maũndũ marĩ magigi na mũtumia wa mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩ, nake ũngĩ ndangĩconoka agĩthũkia mũtumia wa mũriũ, ũngĩ nake agathũkagia mwarĩ wa nyina, o ũcio mwarĩ wa ithe.
english: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

english: Seed tuber weight should be 30 to 50 g to reduce the need for cutting that may introduce infection.

kikuyu: Aathuurire Daudi ndungata yake na akĩmũruta ciugũ-inĩ cia ngʼondu;
english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

kikuyu: Inyuĩ ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, mwetirwo nĩguo mũgĩe na wĩyathi. No rĩrĩ, mũtikahũthĩre wĩyathi wanyu kũrũmagĩrĩra merirĩria ma mwĩrĩ, no handũ ha ũguo-rĩ, tungatanagĩrai inyuĩ-ene mũrĩ na wendani.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, harĩ niĩ-rĩ, andũ a nyũmba ĩno ya Isiraeli matuĩkĩte o ta gĩko kĩrĩa gĩtigaraga rĩrĩa cuuma ĩratherio na mwaki wa ũturi; acio othe matuĩkĩte o ta gĩcango, na ibati, na kĩgera, o na ngocorai marĩ mwaki-inĩ wa ũturi.
