english: How do you control pests in banana plantation?

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Aburamu aiguire atĩ mũndũ ũcio wao nĩanyiitĩtwo agatahwo-rĩ, agĩĩta andũ magana matatũ na ikũmi na anana arĩa maarutĩtwo kũrũa mbaara na maaciarĩirwo gwake mũciĩ, makĩingatithia thũ icio o nginya Dani.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

kikuyu: “Nĩngekĩra mĩhaka yanyu kuuma Iria Itune, ndĩmĩikũrũkie nginya Iria rĩa Afilisti, na kuuma werũ-inĩ nginya Rũũĩ rwa Farati. Andũ arĩa maikaraga kũu nĩngamaneana moko-inĩ manyu, na inyuĩ mũmaingate mamweherere.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩhe anene a ita a thigari 100 matimũ na ngo iria nene na nini iria ciarĩ cia Mũthamaki Daudi iria ciarĩ thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Ngai.
english: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa aaragia maũndũ macio, hagĩũka mũndũ warĩ mũnene, akĩmũturĩria ndu, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũirĩtu wakwa no hĩndĩ aakua; no ũka ũkamũigĩrĩre guoko, na nĩekũriũka.”
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

kikuyu: Thĩ yothe nĩĩtigĩre Jehova; andũ othe a thĩ nĩmamũtĩĩe.
english: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

kikuyu: Nītūtambi tūrīkū kaingī tūthīnagia mīkorobia?
english: What are the common pests that affect avocado production?

kikuyu: Mũthabibũ wao uumĩte mũthabibũ-inĩ wa Sodomu, na ũkoima mĩgũnda-inĩ ya Gomora. Thabibũ ciayo ciyũrĩte thumu, nacio ikũmba ciacio ikarũra.
english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

kikuyu: Andũ a Babuloni makiunanga itugĩ cia gĩcango, na metha cia kũigĩrĩrwo indo, na Karia karĩa kaarĩ ga gĩcango, iria ciarĩ thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Jehova, magĩkuua gĩcango kĩu gĩothe magĩgĩtwara Babuloni.
english: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Solomoni aarĩkirie mahooya macio mothe na gũthaitha Jehova-rĩ, agĩũkĩra, akĩehera mbere ya kĩgongona kĩa Jehova, harĩa aaturĩtie ndu aambararĩtie moko make na igũrũ.
english: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to Yahweh, he arose from before Yahweh’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo makaarora thĩ mone o mĩnyamaro, na nduma, na kĩeha gĩa kũmakania, nao nĩmagaikio nduma-inĩ ndumanu.
english: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, kũu Gĩathĩ-inĩ-rĩ, Ayahudi nĩmamũcaragia, makĩũranagia atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũcio arĩ ha?”
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

kikuyu: Kũrĩ mũthenya barigici, o magĩkuonaga-rĩ, ruta mĩrigo yaku nja ĩrĩ mĩohe nĩ ũndũ wa gũthiĩ bũrũri wa ithaamĩrio. Ningĩ hwaĩ-inĩ, umagare ũthiĩ o magĩkuonaga, o ta ũrĩa andũ mathaamaga.
english: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩ, mũndũ mwaganu angĩgarũrũka atigane na mehia mothe marĩa ekĩte, na arũmie watho wakwa wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo, na ekage maũndũ ma kĩhooto na marĩa magĩrĩire, ti-itherũ nĩegũtũũra muoyo; we ndagakua.
english: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

kikuyu: Nī gīthimi kīrīkū kīa ūrigarī kībatiī kūgacīra ūkūria wa marigū?
english: What temperature do banana require to grow?

kikuyu: Ũguo noguo eekire matũũra-inĩ ma Manase, na Efiraimu, na Simeoni o nginya Nafitali, o na kũrĩa kwanangĩku kwamarigiicĩirie,
english: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.

kikuyu: Kīro kīa marigū ñī kībatiī gūcīarithanio?
english: Do banana flowers need to be pollinated?

kikuyu: Jehova, Ngai wa maithe mao, akĩmatũmĩra ndũmĩrĩri na tũnua twa atũmwo ake rĩngĩ na rĩngĩ, nĩgũkorwo nĩaiguagĩra andũ ake tha, o na gĩikaro gĩake.
english: Yahweh, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place;

kikuyu: na ũthondekithie magĩe na mũtararĩko mwega wa ũbumba; wĩra ũcio ũrutwo nĩ mũthondeki mũũgĩ wa maguta. Makorwo mekĩrĩtwo cumbĩ, na marĩ matheru na makaamũrwo.
english: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

kikuyu: Kaingī matunda marīa makūrū nīmo marwaraga mūno o na gūkorwo marīa manini o namo nīmarwaraga na makagwa kuuma mītī-inī.
english: Mature fruits are most likely to be attacked but young fruits also drop.

kikuyu: “Ũũ nĩguo Jehova ekuuga, o we ũrĩa wombire thĩ, Jehova ũrĩa watũmire thĩ ĩgĩe ho, na akĩmĩhaanda, Jehova nĩrĩo rĩĩtwa rĩake:
english: “Yahweh who does it, Yahweh who forms it to establish it—Yahweh is his name, says:

kikuyu: Ndingĩathĩkĩire arutani akwa, kana thikĩrĩrie ataarani akwa.
english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

kikuyu: Dawa ya planter box nīīteithagia mbegū kuumana na thuraku na mūgagaca no hīndīīria ciarīkia kūhandwo dawa īno ndīngīteithia
english: Planter box insecticide seed treatments will reduce damage to the seeds, but will not protect seedlings

kikuyu: Hihi ngūkū ndwaru ikoragwo ihana atīa?
english: How do unhealthy/sick chickens appear?

kikuyu: Mũthamaki aahũthĩrire mĩthandari ĩyo gwaka ngathĩ cia hekarũ ya Jehova o na cia nyũmba ya ũthamaki, na gũthondekera aini inanda cia mũgeeto o na cia kĩnũbi cia kũhũũrwo. Gũtiarĩ indo ta icio cionetwo Juda mbere ĩyo.)
english: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa maatongoretie na arĩa maamumĩte thuutha makĩanĩrĩra makiuga atĩrĩ, “Hosana!”* “Kũrathimwo-rĩ, nĩ ũrĩa ũgũũka na rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani!”
english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna!‡ Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!*

kikuyu: Niĩ-rĩ, ndĩ iria rĩa maaĩ, kana nyamũ ĩrĩa nene ĩtũũraga iria thĩinĩ kũrĩa kũriku, atĩ nĩkĩo nangagĩrwo?
english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

kikuyu: Ngai nĩamarutire bũrũri wa Misiri; marĩ na hinya o ta ndegwa ya gĩthaka.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

kikuyu: Na marĩ kũu Tahapanahesi, ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova ĩgĩkinyĩra Jeremia, akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

kikuyu: “Tũma arũme amwe mathiĩ magathigaane bũrũri wa Kaanani, ũrĩa ngũhe andũ a Isiraeli. Tũma mũtongoria ũmwe wao, kuuma o mũhĩrĩga o mũhĩrĩga wa maithe mao.”
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

kikuyu: Jazizi ũrĩa Mũhagari nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra ndũũru cia mbũri. Acio othe nĩo maarĩ anene arĩa marũgamagĩrĩra indo ciothe cia Mũthamaki Daudi.
english: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

kikuyu: Riitho rĩaku rĩa ũrĩo rĩngĩtũma wĩhie-rĩ, rĩkũũre, ũrĩte. Nĩ kaba kĩĩga kĩmwe kĩa mwĩrĩ waku kĩũre gũkĩra mwĩrĩ waku wothe ũikio Jehanamu.
english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.§

kikuyu: Jehova ekaga maũndũ ma ũthingu, na akarũgamĩrĩra kĩhooto kũrĩ arĩa othe ahinyĩrĩrie.
english: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jeroboamu aarĩ mũndũ mũhoti, na rĩrĩa Solomoni onire mũrutĩre wake wa wĩra ũrĩa warĩ mwega, akĩmũtua mũrũgamĩrĩri wa aruti wĩra othe a nyũmba ya Jusufu.
english: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, nĩwe ndĩrakaĩra; hiũha ũũke kũrĩ niĩ. Igua mũgambo wakwa ngĩgũkaĩra.
english: Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

kikuyu: Ihinda rīrī he bata kūeheria mīmera īrīa īrugamīte hakuhī
english: At this point, it is necessary to remove the plants that stand close to each other.

kikuyu: Gūkanya nī gwīka atīa?
english: What is pecking?

kikuyu: Thuutha wa matukũ maingĩ, nĩmũgetwo mũthiĩ ita-inĩ. Mĩaka-inĩ ya thuutha nĩmũgatharĩkĩra bũrũri ũgaakorwo ũhonoketio kuuma mbaara-inĩ, ũrĩa andũ aguo maacookanĩrĩirio kuuma ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ nyingĩ magĩtwarwo irĩma-inĩ icio cia bũrũri wa Isiraeli, kũrĩa gũtũũrĩte gũkirĩte ihooru. Acio marutĩtwo ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ icio, na rĩu acio othe maikaraga na thayũ.
english: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.

kikuyu: Nĩnyonete mũndũ mwaganu na mũndũ ũtarĩ tha agaacĩire ta mũtĩ mũruru ũrĩ o imerero-inĩ rĩaguo,
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

kikuyu: Kĩgũũta kĩĩonaga kĩrĩ kĩũgĩ maitho-inĩ makĩo, gũkĩra andũ mũgwanja arĩa macookagia ũhoro na ũũgĩ.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

kikuyu: Matũũra manyu marĩa manene nĩngamananga na handũ hanyu harĩa haamũre ndĩhoonũhe, o na ndigakenio nĩ mũtararĩko mwega wa maruta manyu.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

kikuyu: Iembe no rīambīrīrie kūgarūrūka rangi handū hanini rangi ūcio ūcoke ūtūngane itunda rīothe.
english: This may occur first in a small area or the change will cover most of the fruit's surface.

kikuyu: maanagĩrĩre, makiugaga atĩrĩ, “Jehova nĩ mũrũngĩrĩru; we nĩwe Rwaro rwakwa rwa Ihiga, na gũtirĩ waganu ũngĩoneka thĩinĩ wake.”
english: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

kikuyu: “Nake ũrĩa wothe wamũkagĩra kaana ta gaka thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, nĩ niĩ aamũkagĩra.
english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũũgĩ arĩ ũhoti mũnene, na mũndũ ũrĩ ũmenyo nĩakĩragĩrĩria kũgĩa na hinya;
english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

kikuyu: no atungate thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova Ngai wake, o ta Alawii arĩa angĩ arĩa matungataga hau mbere ya Jehova.
english: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Hagari arũgamĩrĩire Kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai kĩrĩa kĩrĩ kũu bũrũri wa Arabia, nake nĩwe ũgerekanĩtio na itũũra rĩa Jerusalemu ũrĩa rĩhaana ũmũthĩ, tondũ nĩatũire ũkombo-inĩ hamwe na ciana ciake.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

kikuyu: Kara tūmītaro tūrī na ūraihu wa sentimita mīrongo ītatū(futi īmwe) na ūriku wa kuuma sentimita 0.5 nginya 1.0 na ūhure mbeū ūkūmi na ithano nginya mīrongo īrī o kamūkaro.
english: In the seedbed, sow 15 -20 seeds per 30 cm (1 foot) at a depth of 0.5–1.0 cm.

kikuyu: Nake Melikisedeki mũthamaki wa Salemu‡ akĩrehe mĩgate na ndibei. We aarĩ mũthĩnjĩri wa Mũrungu Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno.
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

kikuyu: Simoni nĩatũtaarĩria ũrĩa Ngai oonanirie wendo wake hĩndĩ ya mbere na ũndũ wa gwĩthuurĩra andũ kuuma kũrĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ nĩguo matuĩke aake.
english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩmo mataaraga ndungata yaku; kũmamenyerera nĩ ũndũ ũrĩ irĩhi inene.
english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ ndũrĩrĩ, kenai hamwe na andũ ake, nĩgũkorwo nĩakarĩhanĩria thakame ya ndungata ciake; acirĩhĩrie harĩ thũ ciake, na ahoroherie bũrũri wake, o na andũ ake.
english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.‡

kikuyu: Nake akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Ta tiira maitho na igũrũ wone atĩ thenge iria ciothe irahaica mahiũ nĩ iria irĩ na manyaga, na iria irĩ na maara, na iria irĩ na marooro; nĩgũkorwo nĩnyonete maũndũ marĩa mothe Labani agwĩkĩte.
english: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.

kikuyu: Nake akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ wega, nĩgũtuĩke o ũguo mwoiga. Ũrĩa ũgũkorwo nakĩo nĩwe ũgũtuĩka ngombo yakwa; inyuĩ arĩa angĩ mũtirĩ na ũcuuke.”
english: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

kikuyu: Akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ĩno nĩyo thakame yakwa ya kĩrĩkanĩro, ĩrĩa ĩitĩtwo nĩ ũndũ wa andũ aingĩ.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

kikuyu: Rīrīa kīro kīrekūmba, kīambagia kuonania tūhūa tūnini
english: As the bud unfolds, it reveals double rows of tiny flowers.

kikuyu: Matukũ-inĩ macio, o ihinda-inĩ rĩu-rĩ, ihĩtia rĩa Isiraeli nĩrĩgathuthuurio, no rĩtikoneka, o na mehia ma Juda mathuthuurio, no matikooneka, nĩgũkorwo matigari marĩa ngaahonokia nĩngamarekera,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the iniquity of Israel will be sought for, and there will be none, also the sins of Judah, and they won’t be found; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

kikuyu: Thuutha-inĩ ũcio Jusufu akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ, “Thoguo nĩ mũrũaru.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩoya ariũ ake eerĩ, Manase na Efiraimu, agĩthiĩ kũmũrora.
english: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maaiguire ũguo, makĩbatithio thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani Jesũ.
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Elija akiuma kũu, agĩthiĩ agĩkora Elisha mũrũ wa Shafatu. Aaciimbaga na ndegwa ikũmi na igĩrĩ ciohanĩtio na macooki igĩrĩ igĩrĩ, nowe aatwarithagia icooki rĩa ikũmi na meerĩ. Elija agĩthiĩ harĩ we na akĩmũikĩria nguo yake ya igũrũ.
english: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ũmwe wa arutwo acio eerĩ arĩa maiguĩte ũrĩa Johana oigĩte na makĩrũmĩrĩra Jesũ aarĩ Anderea, mũrũ wa nyina na Simoni Petero.
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

kikuyu: Ngai witũ nĩ Mũrungu ũhonokanagia; Mwathani Jehova nĩwe rĩũrĩro rĩa kuuma gĩkuũ-inĩ.
english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

kikuyu: No Solomoni ndaatuire mũndũ o na ũmwe wa Isiraeli ngombo; nĩo maarĩ andũ ake a kũrũa mbaara, na atongoria a thirikari yake, na anene ake, na atongoria a thigari, na aathi a ngaari cia ita, na atwari a cio.
english: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio nĩmũkamenya atĩ niĩ ndĩ thĩinĩ wa Baba, na inyuĩ mũrĩ thĩinĩ wakwa, na niĩ ndĩ thĩinĩ wanyu.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

kikuyu: Hihi mīūngūrwa īthathaūragwo atīa?
english: How is thinning done?

kikuyu: Andũ acio eerĩ makĩũria Loti atĩrĩ, “Ũrĩ na andũ angĩ aku gũkũ, ta arĩa mahikĩtie airĩtu aku, aanake kana airĩtu aku, kana mũndũ ũngĩ waku o wothe ũrĩ itũũra-inĩ rĩĩrĩ inene? Moimagarie muume gũkũ,
english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, tiga hĩndĩ ya ngano yambire kũgũa tĩĩri-inĩ ĩkue-rĩ, ĩtũũraga ĩrĩ iiki. No ĩngĩkua, nĩĩciaraga maciaromaingĩ.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũrĩa ũũhooreragia ndĩ mĩnyamaro-inĩ nĩ ũyũ: atĩ kĩĩranĩro gĩaku nĩkĩo gĩtũũragia muoyo wakwa.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmatiga, agĩthiĩ, akĩhooya rĩngĩ riita rĩa gatatũ, akiuga ciugo o ro icio.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Naguo Ũhoro-ũyũ-Mwega wa ũthamaki nĩũkahunjio thĩ yothe ũtuĩke ũira kũrĩ ndũrĩrĩ ciothe, na thuutha ũcio ithirĩro rĩkinye.
english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

kikuyu: Kuuma Benjamini nĩ: Eliada, mũthigari njamba, na aarĩ na andũ 200,000 arĩa maarĩ na mota na ngo;
english: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, Mwathani Jehova nĩarooka arĩ na ũhoti, na guoko gwake nĩkuo gũgaathanaga. Atĩrĩrĩ, kĩheo gĩake arĩ nakĩo, o na irĩhi rĩake arĩ narĩo.
english: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩhutia ũrĩrĩ ũcio no nginya athambie nguo ciake na ethambe na maaĩ, na atiinde arĩ na thaahu o nginya hwaĩ-inĩ.
english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Kũngĩkaagĩa maciira magooti-inĩ manyu mũtangĩhota gũtua, marĩ ma ũiti wa thakame, o na ma gũtuithania mũndũ na mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩ, kana mũndũ ũhũũrĩte ũrĩa ũngĩ, matwaragei handũ harĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu agaathuura.
english: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God chooses.

kikuyu: No inyuĩ-rĩ, ciaranai na mũingĩhe; muongerereke thĩ na mũiyũre kuo.”
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”

kikuyu: Petero agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũyũ, niĩ ndiũĩ ũrĩa ũroiga!” Na hĩndĩ o ĩyo oigaga ũguo, ngũkũ ĩgĩkũga.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngoro yakwa nĩnjanjamũku, naruo rũrĩmĩ rwakwa rũgakena; o naguo mwĩrĩ wakwa nĩũgũtũũra ũrĩ na mwĩhoko,
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

kikuyu: na hunjanagĩrie ũhoro wa mwaka ũrĩa Jehova akoonania ũtugi wake, na mũthenya ũrĩa Ngai witũ akerĩhĩria, ningĩ hooragĩrie arĩa othe marĩ na kĩeha,
english: to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

kikuyu: na ũmoohe tũmĩcibi twa mũtwe. Ningĩ wohe Harũni na ariũ ake mĩcibi. Ũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩ wao ũrĩ watho wa kũrũmagĩrĩrwo tene na tene. Ũguo nĩguo ũkaamũra Harũni na ariũ ake.
english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

kikuyu: Thoko: Mūigana na mūthemba wa ngūkū iria nyendie(ngūkū īrarekia, jogoo, mīera), matumbī marīa mendie, kūria mendetio na rītwa ria mūgūri, matumbī na ngūkū iria irītwo, baida kuuma wendia wa ngūkū, iheo, matumbī na ngūkū iria irītwo nīandū a bamīrī na arata, ngarama ciothe cia irio ibatiī kwandīkwo hamwe na mūigana, thogora, na mūthī ūrīa irio icio ciagūrirwo. Angīkorūo ūgūraga irio kuuma kūrīarīa mendagia irio, andīka rīītwa rīa mwendia na ihinda rīrīa wagūra irio icio.
english: Market: number and chicken type sold (hen, cock, grower, chicken), eggs sold, where and to whom sold, eggs/chicken consumed and to whom, income from sale of eggs, gifts and home consumption of eggs and chickens by your family and friends should also be noted, all expenditures for feed or feed ingredients should be registered carefully, noting quantities, price and date of purchase. If you buy feed from feed sellers, note the name of the seller and the time of purchase.

kikuyu: Thuurai mataaro makwa handũ ha betha, mũthuure ũmenyo handũ ha thahabu ĩrĩa njega mũno,
english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

kikuyu: No mũndũ angĩkorwo athũire mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake, nake amuoherie njĩra-inĩ, amũtharĩkĩre amũũrage, acooke orĩre itũũra-inĩ rĩmwe rĩa macio-rĩ,
english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

kikuyu: “Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ: ‘Mũisiraeli o wothe kana mũgeni o wothe ũrĩa ũtũũraga bũrũri wa Isiraeli ũkaaheana ũmwe wa ciana ciake kũrĩ ngai ĩrĩa ĩtagwo Moleku, no nginya akooragwo. Mũingĩ wothe nĩ ũkaamũhũũra na mahiga nyuguto.
english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring† to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, thuutha wa ariũ a nyina gũthiĩ Gĩathĩ-inĩ kĩu, o nake agĩcooka agĩthiĩ, no ndaathiire akĩ- menyekaga, no aathiire na hitho.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

kikuyu: na ndangĩetĩkĩririe mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ahĩtũkĩrie kĩndũ gĩa kwendia kũu nja cia hekarũ.‡
english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

kikuyu: Handũ ha ũguo-rĩ, twagĩrĩirwo tũmaandĩkĩre marũa, tũmeere metheemage kuumana na irio iria ithaahĩtio nĩ mĩhianano, ningĩ metheemage kuumana na ũmaraya, na kuumana na nyama cia nyamũ cia gũitwo, o na kuumana na thakame.
english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

kikuyu: Kũigua ũguo-rĩ, Shimei agĩtandĩka ndigiri yake, agĩthiĩ kwa Akishi kũu Gathu gwetha ngombo ciake. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Shimei agĩthiĩ na agĩcookia ngombo ciake kuuma Gathu.
english: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ eerĩ, nĩo Musa na Elija,
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

kikuyu: “No nyende gũgũcookeria ũhoro, wee hamwe na arata aku.
english: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

kikuyu: Maūndū marīa mabata mūno kūrora ūrīmi-inī wa maembe nī hīndī ya riūa mītī īkīruta mahūa na ūrugarī mwega rīrīa maembe mareruha.
english: Most important considerations for Mango production are a dry period at flowering and sufficient heat during ripening

kikuyu: Hīndī īria wahurania tīri wega na kūwotithia riūa gūteithagia atīa gūthaitīra mīrimū ya kabici
english: How does soil solarization control pests and diseases in cabbage production?

kikuyu: “Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova, Ngai wa andũ othe. Nĩ harĩ ũndũ o na ũmwe mũritũ harĩ niĩ?
english: “Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ ũndũ aameeraga atekwaria na ngerekano. No rĩrĩa maarĩ na arutwo ake oiki, nĩamataragĩria maũndũ mothe.
english: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

kikuyu: ningĩ angĩkorwo nĩ kũũmĩrĩria andũ, nĩakĩũmanagĩrĩrie; na angĩkorwo nĩ wa kũrũmbũiya mabata ma andũ arĩa angĩ, nĩakĩheanage na ũtaana; angĩkorwo nĩ wa gũtongoria, nĩatongoragie na kĩyo; ningĩ ũrĩa wa kũiguanĩra tha, nĩekage ũguo akenete.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo bũrũri ũrĩa mũngʼaru nĩngaũitĩrĩria maaĩ, nakuo kũndũ kũrĩa kũmũ nĩgũgathereraga tũrũũĩ; naruo rũciaro rwaku nĩngarũitĩrĩria Roho wakwa, nacio njiaro cianyu ndĩciitĩrĩrie kĩrathimo gĩakwa.
english: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;

kikuyu: na hũngũ ĩrĩa ndune na mũthemba o wothe wa hũngũ iria njirũ,
english: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

kikuyu: Gitīra mūmera dūkagūe
english: prevent the plants from falling;

kikuyu: Utígithúkanio úyú úteithagia híndí ya kúrora tútambi, mírímú, kúgetha na raithi kúhuhíra
english: The spacing makes it easy for you to scout for pests and diseases, harvest, and spray the farm.

kikuyu: Magĩthondeka gakuo ga gwĩkĩrwo ga gĩthũri; karĩ wĩra wa mũbundi mũũgĩ. Magĩgathondeka o ta ebodi ĩyo: karĩ ga thahabu, na ka ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega.
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Jehova Ngai wanyu nĩwe mũrĩrũ- magĩrĩra, na nĩwe mũrĩĩtigagĩra. Menyagĩrĩrai maathani make na mũmathĩkagĩre; mũtungatagĩrei na mwĩgwatanagie nake.
english: You shall walk after Yahweh your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

kikuyu: Nĩagatuĩra ndũrĩrĩ ciira, aige ciimba irũndo, na ahehenje aathani a thĩ yothe.
english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Mīthemba ya maembe īrīa yonekaga kaingī nī īrīkū?
english: What are the common mango varities?

kikuyu: Wee igũrũ, anĩrĩra nĩ gũkena; nawe thĩ ũcanjamũke, na inyuĩ irĩma-rĩ, inai rwĩmbo! Nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩahooreretie andũ ake, nao andũ ake arĩa anyariire akamaiguĩra tha.
english: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For Yahweh has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩona atĩ nĩmendaga kũmũũria ũhoro ũcio, nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kũũrania mũrorania ũrĩa ngwendaga kuuga rĩrĩa njugire atĩ ‘Thuutha wa kahinda kanini mũtikũnyona rĩngĩ, na ningĩ thuutha wa kahinda kanini nĩmũkũnyona’?
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

kikuyu: No nĩamahonokirie nĩ ũndũ wa rĩĩtwa rĩake, nĩguo atũme hinya wake mũnene ũmenyeke.
english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

kikuyu: “Ciiragĩrĩrai kĩhooto kĩa arĩa matarĩ hinya na arĩa matarĩ maithe; tũũriai ihooto cia andũ arĩa athĩĩni o na arĩa ahinyĩrĩrie.
english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

kikuyu: “No wee-rĩ, cooka mũciĩ. O wakinya itũũra-inĩ inene-rĩ, noguo mwana ũcio arĩkua.
english: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Shauli aakuire, Baali-Hanani mũrũ wa Akibori agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ũhoro ũrĩa niĩ ndaamũkĩrire nĩguo ndaamũheire, ũrĩ wa mbere na wa bata mũno: atĩ Kristũ nĩakuire nĩ ũndũ wa mehia maitũ o ta ũrĩa Maandĩko moigĩte,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: Ningĩ ngĩgũra ngombo cia arũme na cia andũ-a-nja, na nĩ ndaarĩ na ngombo ingĩ iria ciaciarĩirwo gwakwa mũciĩ. O na nĩ ndaarĩ na ndũũru nyingĩ cia mbũri na cia ngʼombe gũkĩra arĩa othe maarĩ Jerusalemu mbere yakwa.
english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo o na nĩnyonete kĩgongona kĩandĩkĩtwo maandĩko maya: KŨRĨ NGAI ĨRĨA ĨTOĨO, rĩrĩa ngoretwo ngĩceera na ngarora wega indo cianyu iria nyamũre cia kũhooywo. Na rĩrĩ, kĩrĩa mũhooyaga mũtooĩ nĩkĩo ngũmũhe ũhoro wakĩo.
english: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

kikuyu: ītarī na maaī, mathangū makahoha.
english: Without water, the leaves wilt.

kikuyu: Thuutha wake, Judasi ũrĩa woimĩte Galili akĩĩyumĩria matukũ-inĩ ma kwĩyandĩkithia na agĩtongoria mbũtũ ya andũ nĩguo makararie watho. O nake akĩũragwo, na arũmĩrĩri aake othe makĩhurunjwo.
english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Pilato aigua ũguo, akĩũria kana mũndũ ũcio nĩ wa kuuma Galili.
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

kikuyu: Ngũkũneana kũrĩ arĩa magũcaragia makũrute muoyo, o acio wĩtigagĩra, ngũneane kũrĩ Nebukadinezaru, mũthamaki wa Babuloni na kũrĩ andũ a Babuloni.
english: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte itũũra rĩrĩa rĩrĩ ngumo rĩage gũtiganĩrio, o itũũra rĩu rĩngenagia?
english: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

kikuyu: Moima Rithima, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Rimoni-Perezu.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa thwariga ĩnyootagĩra tũrũũĩ twa maaĩ, no taguo ngoro yakwa ĩkũnyootagĩra, Wee Ngai.
english: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.†

kikuyu: Njanjo ici itatagīrio maitho-inī kana ikaheyanīrio na maaī. Ningī ngūkū no ithecuo.
english: These are administered via the eye or drinking water. Injectable vaccines are also available.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, niĩ nĩngũcooka o kũrĩ andũ aitũ, no ũka, ngũmenyithie ũrĩa andũ aya mageeka andũ aku matukũ marĩa magooka.”
english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũhonokete kũũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora-rĩ, mwĩtharei na mũtikagonderere! Ririkanagai Jehova mũrĩ bũrũri wa kũraya, na mwĩciiragie ũhoro wa Jerusalemu.”
english: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember Yahweh from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”

kikuyu: na maguta ma mũtamaiyũ ma gwakia tawa; na mahuti manungi wega ma gũthondeka maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio, na ũbumba ũrĩa mũnungi wega;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

kikuyu: Ikoro rīkoragwo na mathundo na nīitungu na rīeruha, nīrīcenjagia rangī kuuma ngirini rīgatwīika ria papo mata.
english: Bumpy, fairly thick skin that turns from green to purplish black when ripe;

kikuyu: ūrigiti wa kūhoreria na kūrigīrīria kūrwara rīngī nī ciabata kūrī ngūkū iria hutie.
english: Comfort therapy and preventive measures for secondary infections can be given to affected birds.

kikuyu: Njanjo yagīrīire kūheyanīrwo kīruru-inī kīa nyūmba kana mūtī īgitīīrītwo kuumana na ūtheri wa riūa.
english: Vaccination should be done under a shade (of house or tree) away from direct sunlight

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩthima nja ĩyo: Mĩena yothe ĩna nĩyaiganaine, yarĩ na mĩkono igana‡ kũraiha, na mĩkono igana kwarama. Nakĩo kĩgongona kĩarĩ hau mbere ya hekarũ.
english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

kikuyu: Oima kũu-rĩ, agĩthiĩ agĩtoonya thunagogi yao,
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

kikuyu: Ndũkanacumĩkĩre maũndũ ma mũndũ wa ngũĩ, kana ũthuure njĩra o na ĩmwe yake,
english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

kikuyu: Mīembe ībatiī kūmenyererwo makīria rīrīa īkūīte kīro.
english: Take proper care during the flowering stage.

kikuyu: “Nawe mũrũ wa mũndũ, ratha ũhoro, uuge atĩrĩ, ‘Ũũ nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũhoro-inĩ ũkoniĩ Aamoni na irumi ciao: “ ‘Harĩ rũhiũ rwa njora, harĩ rũhiũ rwa njora, rũcomoretwo rũũragane, na rũthũũĩtwo rũrĩ rwa kũniinana, na rwakũhenia ta rũheni!
english: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

kikuyu: Fesito aigua ũguo, akĩmũgũthũkĩra akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wee Paũlũ nĩkũgũrũka ũgũrũkĩte! Gĩthomo kĩu gĩaku kĩingĩ nĩgĩtũmĩte ũgũrũke.”
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

kikuyu: Andũ acio nĩ ndungata cia Kristũ? (Ngwaria ũguo ta ndĩ mũgũrũku.) Niĩ nĩndĩmakĩrĩte. Nĩndutĩte wĩra na kĩyo kũmakĩra, na ngaikio njeera mahinda maingĩ makĩria yao, na ngahũũrwo na kĩboko makĩria, o na mahinda maingĩ ndanakuhĩrĩria gũkua.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

kikuyu: ndirĩ mwagĩrĩru wa kuonio ũtugi ũyũ wothe na wĩhokeku ũrĩa ũnyonetie niĩ ndungata yaku. Ngĩringa Jorodani-rĩ, ndaarĩ o na rũthanju rwakwa rwiki, no rĩu nduĩkĩte ikundi igĩrĩ.
english: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.

kikuyu: Macini ihuthagīrwo mīgūnda-inī īrīa mīnene nīundu nīihotaga gūtua kahūa kaingī kwa kahinda kanini na ningī ngarama īkoragwo irī nini.
english: Harvesters are often used for larger and more cost-effective harvests.

kikuyu: Makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Twagũthaitha mwathi witũ, nĩ tuokire gũkũ hĩndĩ ya mbere kũgũra irio.
english: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

kikuyu: No nĩ maitho manyu meeyoneire maũndũ macio mothe manene marĩa Jehova ekĩte.
english: but your eyes have seen all of Yahweh’s great work which he did.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Labani agĩtoonya hema ya Jakubu, na hema ya Lea, o na hema ya ndungata iria igĩrĩ cia andũ-a-nja, no ndaigana kuona kĩndũ. Oima hema ya Lea, agĩtoonya ya Rakeli.
english: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

kikuyu: “Nũũ ũyũ ũrekĩra kĩrĩra gĩakwa nduma na ciugo itarĩ na ũmenyo?
english: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

kikuyu: Igũrũ wake kwarũgamĩte aserafi, na o mũserafi ũmwe aarĩ na mathagu matandatũ: nao makehumbĩra mothiũ mao na mathagu meerĩ, namo meerĩ makehumbĩra magũrũ namo, na meerĩ makombũka namo.
english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

kikuyu: Ona angīkorūo gacunjī o gothe ka irigū no kahūthīke gūcīarithania nī thuna īhūthīkaga
english: Although any part of the banana plant can be used to generate tissue culture plants, it is the meristem/shoot tip that is commonly used

kikuyu: Ũcio ũrumĩte na ũkamenereria nũũ? Nũũ ũgũthũkĩire na mũgambo, na ũkamwambararĩria maitho na mwĩtĩĩo? Wee nĩũũkĩrĩire Ũrĩa Mũtheru wa Isiraeli!
english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mĩthenya ĩtatũ yathira thuutha wa Fesito gũkinya kũu bũrũri-inĩ, akiuma Kaisarea akĩambata agĩthiĩ Jerusalemu.
english: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo ũhoro ũrĩa wandĩkĩtwo wĩgiĩ njiarwa cia Adamu. Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Ngai oombire mũndũ-rĩ, amũũmbire na mũhianĩre wa Ngai.
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mangĩkaarega kuoya gĩkombe kĩu kuuma guoko- inĩ gwaku manyue-rĩ, ũkameera atĩrĩ, ‘Ũũ nĩguo Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe ekuuga: No nginya mũnyue!
english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.

kikuyu: Nĩnderahĩire Tito nĩ ũndũ wanyu, na inyuĩ mũtianjonorire. No o ta ũrĩa maũndũ mothe marĩa twamwĩrire maarĩ ma ma-rĩ, noguo kwĩraha gwitũ nĩ ũndũ wanyu harĩ Tito o nakuo gũtuĩkĩte ũhoro wa ma.
english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

kikuyu: Ūgūnyu mūīngī cieni-inī nīnī ūtūmaga njoka ikaingīha mūno na nīūndū ūcio, nīwega gūthondeka mūtaratara mwega wa kūrūa nacio.
english: Wet and humid conditions for animals in pasture is a period of greatest worm challenge and strategic deworming should come at such times.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ andũ akwa, mwĩhumbei nguo ya ikũnia, na mwĩgaragarie mũhu-inĩ; rĩrai na kĩgi, ta ũrĩa mwana wa mũmwe arĩragĩrwo, nĩgũkorwo mwanangi ũcio agaatũhithũkĩra o rĩmwe.
english: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.

kikuyu: Ũmenyo ta ũcio nĩ wa magegania mũno harĩ niĩ, ũrĩ igũrũ mũno ndingĩũkinyĩra.
english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmenya atĩ nĩmendaga mamũtue mũthamaki wao na hinya, nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmeherera o rĩngĩ, akĩambata kĩrĩma-inĩ arĩ wiki.
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, kĩhuhũkanio kĩa Jehova gĩgaatuthũka na mangʼũrĩ, ta kĩhuhũkanio kĩnene gĩkĩharũrũka, nakĩo kĩgũĩre mĩtwe ya andũ arĩa aaganu.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.

kikuyu: “ ‘No rĩrĩ, mũthenya ũcio ngeeka ũndũ ũrĩ ngũrani bũrũri-inĩ wa Gosheni, kũrĩa andũ akwa matũũraga; gũtikagĩa na mĩrumbĩ ya ngi kũu, nĩgeetha ũmenye atĩ niĩ, Jehova, ndĩ bũrũri-inĩ ũyũ.
english: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am Yahweh on the earth.

kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Jonathani eetagwo Meribu-Baali, na nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Mika.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

kikuyu: Nake akĩhooreria kĩhuhũkanio kĩu kĩnene; namo makũmbĩ ma iria rĩu magĩkirio ki.
english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

kikuyu: Ihinda rīa gūtiga gūkamwo na kūruta iria; Rīrī nī ihinda rīabata harī ng'ombe.
english: Dry period: Dry period is a critical component of a dairy cows.

kikuyu: tondũ noyo arĩ nayo ya kwĩhumbĩra. Angĩkĩĩhumbĩra nakĩ agĩkoma? Angaĩra, nĩngamũigua, nĩgũkorwo ndĩ mũigua tha.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

kikuyu: Mathangū magatuīka ma rangi wa ndathi mūthingi-inī wamo, na thutha ūcio mūtī wothe ūgaitīka na ūkue.
english: Leaves become yellow at their bases, then the whole plant wilts and dies.

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio Jesũ, o akĩrutanaga kũu hekarũ-inĩ, akĩanĩrĩra, akiuga atĩrĩ; “Ĩĩ nĩguo, nĩmũnjũũĩ, na mũkamenya kũrĩa nyumĩte. Ndiũkĩte gũkũ nĩ ũndũ wakwa niĩ mwene, no ũrĩa wandũmire nĩ wa ma. Inyuĩ mũtimũũĩ,
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, o inyuĩ nyendete na ngeriragĩria kũmuona, nĩ inyuĩ gĩkeno gĩakwa na thũmbĩ yakwa. Endwa akwa, ũguo nĩguo mũbatiĩ kwĩhaanda mũrũmĩte thĩinĩ wa Mwathani.
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

kikuyu: Nĩngũkũrutĩra igongona rĩa gũgũcookeria ngaatho, na ngaĩre rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova.
english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki wa Isiraeli agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Mwĩrei ũũ: ‘Mũndũ ũrĩa ũreyooha indo cia mbaara ndaagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩtĩĩa ta mũndũ ũrĩa ũraciruta.’ ”
english: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’ ”

kikuyu: Mĩaka ĩyo yathira Jakubu akĩĩra Labani atĩrĩ, “Rĩu kĩĩhe mũtumia wakwa ndĩmũhikie, tondũ nĩndĩrarĩkirie ihinda rĩakwa rĩa gũtungata.”
english: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

kikuyu: “Nĩthũire gũtũũra muoyo ũyũ; nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndikũhingĩrĩria mateta makwa, o na nĩ ngwaria nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa ngoro yakwa ĩrĩ na marũrũ.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jesũ nĩatongoririo nĩ Roho agĩtwarwo werũ-inĩ akagerio nĩ mũcukani.
english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

kikuyu: Kūharīrīa mūgūnda wa marigū
english: Land preparation for bananas

kikuyu: Nĩmweyoneire na maitho manyu magerio macio manene, o na ciama na maũndũ manene ma kũgegania.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

kikuyu: Hebata ngūkū iria irī na ūgima mwega wa mwīrī ikorwo nīcio ikūheo njanjo īno.
english: It is important to vaccinate only healthy chicken.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jesũ akĩmahe ngerekano ĩno akĩmeera atĩrĩ:
english: He told them this parable:

kikuyu: nĩo maarũgamagĩrĩra aruti a wĩra, na makaroraga aruti othe a wĩra kuuma wĩra ũmwe nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ. Alawii amwe maarĩ aigi a maũndũ marĩa maandĩke, na aandĩki-marũa, na aikaria a mĩrango.
english: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites, there were scribes, officials, and gatekeepers.

kikuyu: na Zeleku ũrĩa Mũamoni, na Naharai ũrĩa Mũberothi, ũrĩa wakuuagĩra Joabu mũrũ wa Zeruia indo cia mbaara,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

kikuyu: “Inyuĩ mũtaiguaga, ta iguai, na inyuĩ atumumu-rĩ, ta cũthĩrĩriai, nĩguo muone!
english: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.

kikuyu: Nake oka, nĩakaiguithia andũ a gũkũ thĩ ũrĩa mahĩtĩtie ũhoro-inĩ wa mehia, na ũhoro-inĩ wa ũthingu, o na ũhoro-inĩ wa ciira:
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

kikuyu: Wahota kuumagaragia njata iria ciĩtagwo Mazarothu o mahinda maacio maakinya, kana wahota gũtongoria Nduba na ciana ciayo?
english: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

kikuyu: Jehova aarĩ hamwe nake; akĩmũtuga na agĩtũma etĩkĩrĩke maitho-inĩ ma mũnene wa njeera.
english: But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa kuuma Refidimu, magĩtoonya werũ wa Sinai, nao andũ a Isiraeli makĩamba hema ciao kũu werũ-inĩ, magũrũ-inĩ ma kĩrĩma kĩu kĩa Sinai.
english: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

kikuyu: Kũrĩa thingo ciaku ciirigĩire kũrogĩa na thayũ, naguo ũgitĩri ũgĩe ciikaro-inĩ ciaku cia ũthamaki.”
english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

kikuyu: We ũcio Rũgai rwa Jakubu ndatariĩ tayo, nĩgũkorwo nĩwe Mũũmbi wa indo ciothe, o hamwe na Isiraeli mũhĩrĩga ũrĩa, eegwatĩire ũtuĩke igai rĩake, Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, nĩrĩo rĩĩtwa rĩake.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

kikuyu: Macio nĩmo mawatho makoniĩ mũrimũ o ro wothe wa ngoothi ũrĩa ũngĩgwatanio, na ũhere,
english: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

kikuyu: “ ‘Ihinda rĩothe rĩa mwĩhĩtwa ũcio wa kwĩyamũra, ndakanenjwo mũtwe. No nginya aikarage arĩ mũtheru o nginya ihinda rĩake rĩa kwĩyamũrĩra Jehova rĩthire; no nginya areke njuĩrĩ cia mũtwe wake ikũre iraihe.
english: “ ‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

kikuyu: Aarĩ na ndũũru nyingĩ cia mbũri na cia ngʼombe, na ndungata nyingĩ, o nginya Afilisti makĩmũiguĩra ũiru.
english: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

kikuyu: Jothamu nĩarũire mbaara na mũthamaki wa Amoni na akĩmahoota. Mwaka-inĩ ũcio, Aamoni nĩmamũrĩhire taranda igana rĩmwe* cia betha, na kori 10,000† cia ngano, na kori 10,000 cia cairi. Andũ a Amoni nĩmamũreheire indo o ta icio mwaka-inĩ wa keerĩ na wa gatatũ.
english: He also fought with the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. The children of Ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents† of silver, ten thousand cors‡ of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley.§ The children of Ammon also gave that much to him in the second year, and in the third.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ! Nderi nĩĩkombũka na ĩcuuhũke, ĩtambũrũkĩtie mathagu mayo igũrũ rĩa Bozara. Mũthenya ũcio-rĩ, ngoro cia njamba iria irĩ hinya cia Edomu igaatuĩka ta ngoro ya mũndũ-wa-nja akĩrũmwo.
english: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ nĩmwĩtigĩrĩte rũhiũ rwa njora, na rũhiũ rũu rwa njora no ruo ngaamũũkĩrĩra naruo, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.
english: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩ kaba mũmũtambũrũkĩrie guoko, na mũmũkombithie kĩrĩa gĩothe akaabatario nĩkĩo.
english: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, niĩ ndungata yaku, na Zadoku ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na Benaia mũrũ wa Jehoiada, na ndungata yaku Solomoni ndanatwĩta.
english: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.

kikuyu: Mũkaaniinwo o ta ndũrĩrĩ iria Jehova aaniinire agĩcieheria mbere yanyu, nĩ ũndũ wa kwaga gwathĩkĩra Jehova Ngai wanyu.
english: As the nations that Yahweh makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

kikuyu: Matukũ-inĩ make-rĩ, Juda nĩakahonokio, nake Isiraeli atũũre arĩ mũgitĩre. Nake ageetagwo rĩĩtwa rĩrĩ: Jehova-Ũthingu-Witũ.”
english: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.

kikuyu: Hinya wakwa ũniarĩte ta rũgĩo, naruo rũrĩmĩ rwakwa rũkanyiitana na karakara nĩkũngʼara; ũngometie rũkũngũ-inĩ rwa gĩkuũ.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

kikuyu: No niĩ nĩwe ndĩhokete, Wee Jehova, ngoiga atĩrĩ, “Wee nĩwe Ngai wakwa.”
english: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”

kikuyu: Mũngĩĩka ũguo nao mangaĩre, hatirĩ nganja nĩngaigua kĩrĩro kĩao.
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

kikuyu: Ningĩ tuoiga atĩ ‘Woimĩte kũrĩ andũ’, andũ othe nĩmegũtũhũũra na mahiga nyuguto, nĩ ũndũ nĩmetĩkĩtie atĩ Johana aarĩ mũnabii.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

kikuyu: Nĩngagũtua ta rũthingo harĩ andũ aya, ngũtue rũthingo rũrũmu rwa gĩcango; nĩmakarũa nawe, no matigagũtooria, nĩgũkorwo niĩ ndĩ hamwe nawe, nĩguo ngũteithũre na ngũhonokie,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Mũnabii kana mũroti wa irooto angĩkeyumĩria thĩinĩ wanyu, nake amwĩre ũhoro wa kĩama kana wa ũrirũ,
english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

kikuyu: Ndũkanataare mũnyũrũrania, nĩguo ndagagũthũũre; kaania mũndũ mũũgĩ, nake nĩegũkwenda.
english: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

kikuyu: “Thuutha wa Harũni na ariũ ake kũrĩĩkia kũhumbĩra indo ciothe theru o na indo ciothe nyamũre, na rĩrĩa andũ a kambĩ mehaarĩria gũthaama-rĩ, ariũ a Akohathu nao moke makuue indo icio. No matikanahutie indo icio nyamũre matigakue. Akohathu acio nĩo magaakuua indo iria irĩ thĩinĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa ũguo, Iburahĩmu agĩthika Sara mũtumia wake ngurunga-inĩ ĩyo yarĩ gĩthaka-inĩ kĩa Makipela hakuhĩ na Mamure (ĩrĩa ĩrĩ Hebironi), bũrũri-inĩ wa Kaanani.
english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Naguo mweri ũkaara ta riũa, na ũtheri wa riũa ũnenehio maita mũgwanja, ũhaane ta ũtheri wa mĩthenya mũgwanja mĩgima, rĩrĩa Jehova akooha nguraro cia andũ ake na amahonie ironda iria aamatiihirie.
english: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

kikuyu: marigū magethagwo marī methe magacoka makarindwo
english: Bananas are harvested raw and ripened artificially.

kikuyu: Angĩ maagereire iria-inĩ marĩ marikabu-inĩ; maathiiaga wonjoria kũu maria-inĩ manene.
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

english: “Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?”

english: What are some of the common varieties of cabbage grown in Kenya?

english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

english: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, matukũ-inĩ macio kĩrĩndĩ kĩingĩ gĩkĩũngana rĩngĩ. Na tondũ gĩtiarĩ na kĩndũ gĩa kũrĩa- rĩ, Jesũ agĩĩta arutwo ake moke harĩ we, akĩmeera atĩrĩ,
english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

kikuyu: Nĩngatũma ũrĩkĩrĩrie na kĩmako kĩnene, nawe ndũgacooka kuonwo rĩngĩ. Ũgaacaragio na ndũgacooka kuoneka, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.”
english: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

kikuyu: Nake akĩgega nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa maagĩte wĩtĩkio. Jesũ agĩcooka agĩthiĩ akĩrutanaga itũũra gwa itũũra.
english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mbere wa Gĩathĩ kĩa Mĩgate ĩtarĩ Mĩĩkĩre Ndawa ya Kũimbia, o ũrĩa wathĩnjagwo gatũrũme ka Bathaka-rĩ, arutwo a Jesũ makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ũkwenda tũthiĩ kũ tũkahaarĩrie nĩguo ũkarĩĩre irio cia Bathaka kuo?”

kikuyu: kana mwĩhĩte na thĩ, nĩgũkorwo nĩkuo gĩturwa gĩa kũigĩrĩra magũrũ make; o na kana mwĩhĩte na Jerusalemu, nĩgũkorwo nĩrĩo itũũra inene rĩa Mũthamaki mũnene.
english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

kikuyu: Musa, na Harũni marĩ na kĩrĩndĩ kĩu gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli magĩĩka Alawii o ta ũguo Jehova aathĩte Musa.
english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ, “Matukũ nĩmarooka rĩrĩa ngaarahũrĩra Daudi mũndũ mũthingu ũgerekanĩtio na Rũhonge rwa mũtĩ, na nĩwe Mũthamaki ũrĩa ũgaathamakaga arĩ na ũũgĩ, na ageekaga maũndũ marĩa magĩrĩire na ma kĩhooto bũrũri-inĩ.

kikuyu: o hamwe na mahiũ manyu na nyamũ cia gĩthaka iria itũũraga bũrũri wanyu. Kĩrĩa gĩothe bũrũri ũcio ũgaaciara no kĩrĩĩo.
english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

kikuyu: No ũtũhehenjete, na ũgatũtua imamo cia mbwe, na ũgatũhumbĩra na nduma nene.
english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Ningĩ kuuma gĩkabũ-inĩ kĩa mĩgate ĩrĩa yarugĩtwo ĩtarĩ ndawa ya kũimbia, kĩrĩa kĩarĩ hau mbere ya Jehova, akĩoya kamũgate, na kamũgate kangĩ kaarugĩtwo na maguta, na kamũgate kangĩ kahũthũ; agĩtũigĩrĩra igũrũ rĩa icunjĩ cia maguta macio na kĩero-inĩ kĩu kĩa ũrĩo.
english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

kikuyu: Uugaga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ niĩ thuuraga hĩndĩ ĩrĩa njagĩrĩru; nĩ niĩ nduanagĩra ciira na kĩhooto.
english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩĩta Johanani mũrũ wa Karea, marĩ na anene othe a mbũtũ cia ita acio maarĩ nake, o na andũ acio angĩ othe kuuma ũrĩa mũnini nginya ũrĩa mũnene, makĩũngana hamwe.

kikuyu: Korwo ndariĩ ũrĩa ndatariĩ matukũ-inĩ marĩa ndagaacĩire biũ, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa kuumĩrania ngoro na Ngai kwarathimaga nyũmba yakwa,
english: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

kikuyu: O rĩngĩ Jesũ akĩigĩrĩra mũndũ ũcio moko maitho. Hĩndĩ ĩyo maitho make makĩhingũka, agĩcooka kuona na akĩona indo ciothe wega.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Solomoni agĩthiĩ Jerusalemu oimĩte handũ harĩa hatũũgĩru kũu Gibeoni hau mbere ya Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo. Nake agĩthamakĩra Isiraeli.
english: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.

kikuyu: Nī bataraitha īrīkū ya mathangū njega mūno gūkū Kenya na nīrī ībatiī kūhūrwo mītī?
english: Best foliar fertilizer for coffee in Kenya and when to spray?

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ aamenya ũrĩa meeranaga, akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ a wĩtĩkio mũnini, nĩ kĩĩ kĩratũma mwaranĩrie ũhoro wa kwaga mĩgate?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

kikuyu: Wee ngoro yakwa, ũkĩritũhĩirwo nĩkĩ? Ũrathĩĩnĩka ũguo nĩkĩ ũrĩ thĩinĩ wakwa? Wĩrĩgagĩrĩre Ngai, nĩgũkorwo no ndĩrĩmũgoocaga, o we Mũhonokia wakwa na Ngai wakwa.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

kikuyu: Nĩ ngaatho ngũgũcookeria, nĩgũkorwo nĩwanjĩtĩkire; nĩũtuĩkĩte ũhonokio wakwa.
english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Mishima ciarĩ: Mũriũ Hamueli, na Zakuri mũriũ wa Hamueli, na Shimei mũriũ wa Zakuri.
english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, rĩrĩa mũrathiĩ na thũ yaku kũrĩ mũciirithania-rĩ, geria mũno wĩiguithanie nayo mũrĩ o njĩra-inĩ, ndĩgagũkururie ĩgũtware kũrĩ mũciirithania, nake mũciirithania akũneane kũrĩ mũnene, nake mũnene ũcio agũikie njeera.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

kikuyu: Hilikia aarĩ wa keerĩ, nake Tabalia aarĩ wa gatatũ, na Zekaria aarĩ wa kana. Ariũ a Hosa na andũ a nyũmba yao othe maarĩ andũ 13.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

kikuyu: Jehieli, na Azazia, na Nahathu, na Asaheli, na Jerimothu, na Jozabadu, na Elieli, na Isimakia, na Mahathu, na Benaia nĩo maarĩ arũgamĩrĩri rungu rwa Konania na mũrũ wa ithe Shimei, ta ũrĩa gwatuĩtwo nĩ Mũthamaki Hezekia na Azaria ũrĩa warĩ mũnene wa hekarũ ya Ngai.
english: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

kikuyu: Nĩndacookanĩrĩirie betha na thahabu, na indo cia bata iria cia athamaki o na cia mabũrũri. Ningĩ ngĩgĩa na aini a arũme na a andũ-a-nja, o na thuriya nyingĩ mũno: maũndũ marĩa makenagia ngoro ya mũndũ.

english: Do not provide any other drinking water until all of the vaccine mixture has been consumed

english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

english: They help eliminate scraps, produce a natural fertiliser, get rid of pesky garden pests, assist with composting and provide fresh, free-range eggs!

english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning. 18

english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

english: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

kikuyu: Meere atĩrĩ, ‘Niĩ ndĩ kĩmenyithia harĩ inyuĩ.’ “O ta ũguo niĩ njĩkĩte, noguo o nao mageekwo. Nĩmagatwarwo bũrũri wa kũngĩ marĩ atahe.
english: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

english: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”*

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthenya ũcio nĩũkoiga atĩrĩ, “Nĩngũkũgooca, Wee Jehova. O na gũtuĩka nĩwaandakarĩire-rĩ, nĩũnjehereirie marakara maku na ũkaahooreria.

english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.

english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndũkamwĩtigĩre, nĩ ũndũ nĩndĩmũneanĩte hamwe na mbũtũ ciake ciothe cia ita na bũrũri wake moko-inĩ maku. Mwĩke o ũrĩa wekire Sihoni mũthamaki wa Aamori, ũrĩa waathanaga Heshiboni.”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

kikuyu: Meere atĩrĩ, ‘Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: Mũngĩrega kũnjigua na kũrũmĩrĩra mawatho makwa marĩa njigĩte mbere yanyu,
english: You shall tell them, “Yahweh says: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law which I have set before you,

kikuyu: Nĩndakinyĩrĩirie ndũrĩrĩ ndĩ na marakara, ngĩtũma ituĩke ta irĩĩtwo nĩ njoohi nĩ ũndũ wa mangʼũrĩ makwa, nayo thakame yao ngĩmĩita thĩ.”
english: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, kwaria na thiomi nĩ kĩmenyithia kũrĩ andũ arĩa matetĩkĩtie no ti kĩmenyithia kũrĩ arĩa metĩkĩtie; no kũratha ũhoro nĩ kwa arĩa metĩkĩtie, ti kwa arĩa matetĩkĩtie.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

kikuyu: Kanua ka mũndũ ũrĩa mũthingu karehaga ũũgĩ, no rũrĩmĩ rwa ũtũrĩka nĩrũkaniinwo.
english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

kikuyu: Ahabu mũrũ wa Omuri nĩekire maũndũ maingĩ mooru maitho-inĩ ma Jehova, makĩria ya mũndũ o wothe wa arĩa maarĩ mbere yake.
english: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight above all that were before him.

kikuyu: Ũkai mũthikĩrĩrie inyuothe arĩa mwĩtigĩrĩte Ngai; rekei ndĩmũhe ũhoro wa ũrĩa anjĩkĩire.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

kikuyu: Andũ a Nineve nĩmakarũgama hĩndĩ ya ciira hamwe na rũciaro rũrũ marũtuĩre ciira; nĩgũkorwo nĩmeririre rĩrĩa maahunjĩirio nĩ Jona, na rĩu ũmwe mũnene gũkĩra Jona arĩ haha.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

kikuyu: Ndũkanareke arĩa macambanagia magaacĩre bũrũri-inĩ; mwanangĩko ũrothingata andũ arĩa mahũthagĩra ũhinya.
english: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

kikuyu: Nyama ya itunda nī ya rangi wa ngoikoni, nīīrī cama, ndīrī ndigi na mūtararīko ūtarī mūnene.
english: The flesh is yellow, juicy, fibreless and with a mild flavour.

kikuyu: No ithe angĩmũkaania aigua ũhoro wa mĩĩhĩtwa ĩyo, hatirĩ o na kĩmwe kĩa mĩĩhĩtwa ĩyo yake, kana ciĩranĩro icio ehingĩte nacio we mwene, igatũũra; nake Jehova nĩakamũrekera nĩ ũndũ ithe nĩamũgirĩtie eke ũndũ ũcio.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

kikuyu: Mūgūnda wa mīembe ūrīmagīrwo atīa?
english: How to control weeds in mangoes?

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩmamũremeire na makĩiguithia Roho wake Mũtheru ũũru. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmagarũrũka, agĩtuĩka thũ yao, nake we mwene akĩrũa mbaara nao.
english: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa nyina ũcio mũkũrũ akĩrakara na akĩrega gũtoonya nyũmba. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ithe akiuma nja, akĩmũthaitha atoonye thĩinĩ.
english: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

kikuyu: Mĩgũtha ya nyama ciayo nĩmĩnyiitanu mũno; nĩ mĩrũmu ũũ atĩ ndĩngĩenyenyeka.
english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Handũ ha ũguo-rĩ: “Thũ yaku ĩngĩkorwo ĩhũtiĩ-rĩ, mĩhe irio; ĩngĩkorwo nĩĩnyootiĩ-rĩ, mĩhe gĩa kũnyua. Gwĩka ũguo-rĩ, nĩkũmĩigĩrĩra makara ma mwaki mũtwe.”
english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”*

kikuyu: Nake Musa akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩmwarĩkia kwamũrĩrwo Jehova ũmũthĩ, nĩgũkorwo nĩmwareganire na ariũ anyu na mũkĩregana na arĩa mũciaranĩirwo nao, na Jehova nĩamũrathima ũmũthĩ.”
english: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Wee ndũngĩrĩ na ũhoti igũrũ rĩakwa korwo ndũheetwo guo kuuma igũrũ. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ũrĩa ũũneanire kũrĩwe nĩwe ũrĩ na mehia marĩa manene.”
english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

kikuyu: Nake agĩtũma andũ mathiĩ mbere yake kũhaarĩria maũndũ nĩ ũndũ wake, magĩthiĩ magĩtoonya gatũũra kamwe ga Samaria;*
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

kikuyu: Mũtumia ũcio aarĩkia gwĩthiĩra, akĩaũra taama wake, akĩĩhumba nguo ciake cia mũtumia wa ndigwa rĩngĩ.
english: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo arĩa othe matũũraga bũrũri wa Misiri nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova. “ ‘WeeũkoretwoũrĩmũthĩgiwakamũrangiwagũtiiranyũmbayaIsiraeli.
english: “ ‘ “All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

kikuyu: nĩ thimo cia gũtũma mũndũ agĩe na ũũgĩ, na ataarĩke; nĩ cia gũtũma ahote gũtaũkĩrwo nĩ ciugo cia ũũgĩ;
english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

kikuyu: Aarĩkia kũmũthika, akĩĩra ariũ ake atĩrĩ, “Rĩrĩa ngaakua, mũgaathika mbĩrĩra-inĩ ĩno harĩa mũndũ ũyũ wa Ngai athikĩtwo; mũkaiga mahĩndĩ makwa hau mwena-inĩ wa mahĩndĩ make.
english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

kikuyu: Nao arĩa othe maiguire ũhoro ũcio makĩgegio nĩguo makĩũria atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ kaana gaka gagaatuĩka ũ? Nĩgũkorwo guoko kwa Mwathani kwarĩ hamwe nako.”
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, kwarĩ aanake mũgwanja a nyina ũmwe. Wa mbere akĩhikania na agĩkua, na ndatige ciana.
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

kikuyu: O rĩmwe kairĩtu kau gagĩũkĩra, gakĩambĩrĩria gũthiĩ (nako kaarĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ). Nao mona ũguo makĩgega mũno.
english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

kikuyu: Firaũni akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Uma, ũnjeherere! Wĩmenyerere ndũkanooke mbere yakwa rĩngĩ! Mũthenya ũrĩa ũkoona ũthiũ wakwa, no gũkua ũgaakua.”
english: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”

kikuyu: Mūtheba wa Arizona nī wonanagia gūkūra kwa naihenya matukū ma mbere
english: Arizona exhibits good initial development.

kikuyu: • Nīwega kūgarūrīra ihinda rīrīa tīri ūkoragwo ūrī mūmū na mūigū.
english: • Alternate dry and wet spells in the soil

kikuyu: Kushi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Nimurodi ũrĩa wakũrire agĩtuĩka njamba ya ita ĩrĩ hinya thĩinĩ wa thĩ.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

kikuyu: Jesũ aigua ũguo, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Harĩ ũndũ ũmwe ũtigarĩtie gwĩka. Thiĩ wendie kĩrĩa gĩothe ũrĩ nakĩo ũhe athĩĩni mbeeca icio, na nĩũkũgĩa na mũthiithũ igũrũ. Ũcooke ũũke ũnũmĩrĩre.”
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, erekeria ũthiũ waku harĩ Aamoni, na ũmarathĩre ũhoro wa kũmookĩrĩra.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

kikuyu: Angīkorūo mūtugo wa kūgetha kahūa gatarī keeru nīūgūthī na mbere, ūndū ūyū nīūhīngīcaga wūigananu wa maūndū mathī, ūgima mwega wa tīīri na indo iria ciīmuoyo.
english: If there is a consistent practice of harvesting immature cherries, it can disrupt the natural balance of the ecosystem, affecting soil health and biodiversity.

kikuyu: Mīthemba ya SL 34,SL28, and K7 yagīrīirwo nī ūtaganu wa mita 2.74 gwa 2.74 kana (futi 9 gwa 9).
english: SL 34, SL 28, and K7 varieties, the spacing should be 2.74m x 2.74m (9ft × 9ft).

kikuyu: Twagũthaitha ũtige gũtũthũũra, nĩ ũndũ wa rĩĩtwa rĩaku; ndũgaaconorithie gĩtĩ gĩaku kĩa ũnene kĩrĩa kĩrĩ riiri. Ririkana kĩrĩkanĩro kĩrĩa warĩkanĩire na ithuĩ, na ndũgagĩthũkie.
english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.

kikuyu: Mũrũ wakwa, ehia mangĩgakũheenereria-rĩ, ndũkanetĩkanie nao.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

kikuyu: “Andũ arĩa athingu nĩmeyonagĩra mwanangĩko wa acio aaganu, magakena; arĩa matarĩ na ũũru mekĩte mamanyũrũragia makiugaga atĩrĩ:
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

kikuyu: Enzymes iteithagia kūnyihia tūcunjī tūrīa tūnene twa irio nīguo mwīrī ūhote gūcihūthīra wega.
english: The enzymes break down large food molecules for easy absorption.

kikuyu: ‘Jehova nĩaremirwo nĩgũkinyia andũ aya bũrũri ũrĩa aamerĩire na mwĩhĩtwa; nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmooragĩra werũ-inĩ.’
english: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

kikuyu: “Nĩgũkorwo meciiria makwa timo meciiria manyu, o na kana mĩthiĩre yanyu ĩgatuĩka ta mĩthiĩre yakwa,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Hĩ! Kaĩ wee njata ya kĩwariĩ nĩũgwĩte ũkoima igũrũ-ĩ, o wee mũrũ wa rũciinĩ kĩroko gwakĩa! Ũharũrũkĩtio ũgaikio gũkũ thĩ, o wee ũrĩa hĩndĩ ĩmwe wahinyagĩrĩria ndũrĩrĩ!
english: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

kikuyu: ũngĩkorwo ũrĩ mũtheru na mũrũngĩrĩru-rĩ, o na rĩu no arahũke nĩ ũndũ waku nĩguo agũcookie handũ harĩa hakwagĩrĩire.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

kikuyu: Ingihota atīa gūthaitīra mūrimu ūyū wa black rot(mboga kūira)
english: How do I control black rot in cabbages?

kikuyu: Ūrugarī ūrīa wagīrīire nī wa gatagatī ka 20°-24°c.
english: Optimum temperatures of 20°C-24°C;

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo mwendete o arĩa mamwendete-rĩ, mũgaakĩrĩhwo kĩ? Githĩ o na etia mbeeca cia igooti matiĩkaga o ũguo?
english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

kikuyu: “Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ, ‘Matukũ nĩmagooka rĩrĩa ngaahingia kĩĩranĩro gĩakwa kĩa wega kĩrĩa nderĩire nyũmba ya Isiraeli na nyũmba ya Juda.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

kikuyu: Yarĩ na harũkĩrio ya gũtoonyeria mũtwe gatagatĩ kayo, ningĩ ĩgĩtirihwo mĩthia-inĩ ta kara, nĩgeetha ndĩgatarũke.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmeera na njĩra ĩgũtaũka, atĩrĩ, “Lazaro nĩmũkuũ,
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

kikuyu: Na ũrĩa wothe ũtigĩte nyũmba, kana ariũ a nyina, kana aarĩ a nyina, kana ithe, kana nyina, kana ciana, kana mĩgũnda nĩ ũndũ wakwa nĩakamũkĩra maita igana ma iria atigĩte, na agae muoyo wa tene na tene.
english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũkũũranaga maũndũ aikaraga arorete o ũũgĩ, no maitho ma mũndũ mũkĩĩgu morũũraga nginya ituri cia thĩ.
english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Mūgarū na matunda marīa mangī, marigū nī monekaga mwaka-inī wothe
english: Unlike other fruit like apples which have a growing season, bananas are available all year round.

kikuyu: No kuuma rĩu, Mũrũ wa Mũndũ arĩkoragwo aikarĩte guoko-inĩ kwa ũrĩo kwa Ngai ũrĩa Mwene- Hinya.”
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

kikuyu: Hekarũ ya Ngai yakĩhota atĩa kũiguana na mĩhianano? Nĩgũkorwo ithuĩ nĩ ithuĩ hekarũ ya Ngai ũrĩa ũrĩ muoyo. O ta ũrĩa Ngai oigĩte atĩrĩ: “Nĩndĩrĩtũũranagia nao, na njeerage gatagatĩ-inĩ kao, nduĩke Ngai wao, nao matuĩke andũ akwa.”
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”*

kikuyu: Ĩhuragia thĩ na ũcamba ĩgĩkenagĩra hinya wayo, ĩkaguthũka ĩtoonyete mbaara-inĩ.
english: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

kikuyu: “Hezekia mũthamaki wa Juda kana mũndũ ũngĩ wothe kũu Juda nĩamũũragire? Githĩ Hezekia ti gwĩtigĩra eetigĩrire Jehova, na agĩcaria gwĩtĩkĩrĩka nĩwe? Na githĩ Jehova ndeericũkirwo agĩtiga kũrehe mwanangĩko ũrĩa oigĩte nĩekũmarehera? Tũrorete kwĩrehere mwanangĩko mũũru mũno!”
english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way!”

kikuyu: Altitude; mita 0-800 igūrū wa iria, Ihinda rīa Kūgetha; Mweri wa ikūmi na ūmwe nginya wa gatatū, ūritū wa maembe; gramu 425-600 (ūritū wa gatagatī: gramu 523) Mūigana wa iembe; ūraihu nī sentimita 14 na wariīnīsentimita 9.5. Mūtī ūciaraga gatagatī ka maembe 400-600 o kīmera.
english: Altitude; 0-800 metres above sea level Harvest Season; November to March Fruit Weight; 425—600 g (mean: 523 g) Fruit Measures; 14 cm long and 9.5 cm wide Yields; 400-600 fruits/tree/season

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Mũfarisai ũmwe nĩetire Jesũ gwake makarĩanĩre irio cia hwaĩ-inĩ nake, nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jesũ agĩthiĩ nyũmba ya Mũfarisai ũcio, agĩikara metha-inĩ.
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

kikuyu: Jesũ agĩcooka akĩoya mĩgate ĩyo, agĩcookia ngaatho na akĩgaĩra arĩa maikarĩte thĩ kũringana na mũigana ũrĩa o mũndũ angĩendire. Agĩcooka agĩĩka o ũguo na thamaki.
english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

kikuyu: Iburahĩmu agĩtua kaana kau ga kahĩĩ aaciarĩirwo nĩ Sara, Isaaka.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.†

kikuyu: Wee Ngai, ndũrĩrĩ nĩitharĩkĩire igai rĩaku; nĩithaahĩtie hekarũ yaku theru, imomorete itũũra rĩa Jerusalemu rĩgatuĩka irũndo cia mahiga.
english: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

kikuyu: “Kũgĩa na mbaũ nyingĩ mũno cia mĩtarakwa-rĩ, no gũtũme ũtuĩke mũthamaki? Githĩ thoguo ndaarĩ o na gĩa kũrĩa na gĩa kũnyua? Ekaga maũndũ marĩa maagĩrĩire na ma kĩhooto, nĩ ũndũ ũcio maũndũ make mothe makĩgaacĩra.
english: “Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.

kikuyu: O hĩndĩ ĩyo roho ũraahĩtũkĩra o ũthiũ-inĩ wakwa, nacio njuĩrĩ cia mwĩrĩ wakwa irambarara.
english: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

kikuyu: Īhuruta cia kabici
english: * Cabbage white butterfly

kikuyu: Mĩnyamaro-inĩ yakwa ndakaĩire Jehova; ngĩrĩrĩra Ngai wakwa aandeithie. Arĩ hekarũ-inĩ yake nĩ aaiguire mũgambo wakwa; kĩrĩro gĩakwa gĩgĩkinya harĩ we, o matũ-inĩ make.
english: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

kikuyu: Thutha wa kūharīria marima ma kūhanda, īkīra thumu wa gūthondeka na mahuti na bataritha ūcoke ūtukanie na tiiri mūnoru wa igūrū.
english: After the preparation of planting holes, apply manure/compost and basal fertilizer. Mix thoroughly with topsoil
