english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”*

kikuyu: Nao makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kĩĩ gĩatũmire Musa aathane atĩ mũndũ no ahe mũtumia wake marũa ma gũtigana nake, amũte?”
english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

kikuyu: Paũlũ nĩatuĩte itua rĩa gũthiĩ ahĩtũkĩte Efeso na marikabu nĩguo ndagate mahinda kũu bũrũri wa Asia, nĩ ũndũ nĩehĩkaga nĩguo kwahoteka akinye Jerusalemu, mũthenya wa Bendegothito.
english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩeerĩte Musa atĩrĩ, “Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, ‘Inyuĩ mũrĩ andũ momĩtie ngingo. Ingĩtwarana na inyuĩ o na kahinda kanini, ndahota kũmũniina. Rĩu rutai mathaga manyu, na nĩngũmenya ũrĩa ngwĩka na inyuĩ.’ ”
english: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’ ”

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo rĩrĩa kĩrĩndĩ kĩanemeire hau maaĩ- inĩ ma Werũ wa Zini, wee na Harũni inyuĩ eerĩ mũtiathĩkĩire watho wakwa, nĩmwagire kũndĩĩithia nĩguo muonanie atĩ ndĩ mũtheru mbere ya maitho mao.” (Maaĩ macio nĩ marĩa ma Meriba Kadeshi, Werũ-inĩ wa Zini.)
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

kikuyu: Gũtikagĩe mũndũ ũkwambatania hamwe nawe kana onekane handũ o hothe kũu kĩrĩma-inĩ; o na gũtikagĩe ndũũru cia mbũri kana cia ngʼombe ingĩrĩithio kũu mbere ya kĩrĩma.”
english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Menyagĩrĩrai Thabatũ ciakwa, na mũtĩĩage handũ hakwa harĩa haamũre. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.
english: “ ‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nake Iburahĩmu akĩĩra Ngai atĩrĩ, “Naarĩ korwo Ishumaeli atũũra arathimagwo nĩwe!”
english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

kikuyu: Nĩagekĩra ũbani ũcio mwaki-inĩ mbere ya Jehova, nayo ndogo ya ũbani ũcio nĩĩgathiĩka gĩtĩ kĩu gĩa tha, kĩu kĩrĩ igũrũ rĩa ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira, nĩguo ndagakue.
english: He shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

kikuyu: Jusufu agĩĩtĩkĩrĩka maitho-inĩ make na agĩtuĩka wa kũmũtungatĩra. Potifaru akĩmũtua mũrori wa nyũmba yake na akĩmwĩhokera ũmenyereri wa kĩrĩa gĩothe aarĩ nakĩo.
english: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

kikuyu: Rĩa nyama icio o ta ũrĩa ũngĩrĩa nyama cia thwariga kana cia thiiya. Andũ arĩa marĩ na thaahu na arĩa matarĩ no marĩe nyama icio.
english: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

kikuyu: Mūrimū ūyū ūtumaga mathangū marīa manini magaitīka hamwe na mahūa ūngīaga kūgirio gūtherema.
english: They lead to defoliation of young leaves and severe flower abortion if not controlled.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩ, eheria guoko gwaku, gũikare kũraya na niĩ, na ũtige kũũmakia na imakania ciaku.
english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

kikuyu: Nao makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Aca, mwathi witũ! Ndungata ciaku ciũkĩte o kũgũra irio tu.
english: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

kikuyu: Nake agĩĩka maũndũ mooru maitho-inĩ ma Jehova, o ta ũrĩa ithe Manase eekĩte. Amoni nĩahooire na akĩrutĩra mĩhianano yothe magongona ĩrĩa Manase aathondekithĩtie.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.

kikuyu: kĩgongona gĩa gĩcango hamwe na kĩrũtara gĩakĩo gĩa gĩcango na itugĩ ciakĩo na indo ciakĩo ciothe; na kĩraĩ gĩa gwĩthambĩra na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo;
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

kikuyu: Wee wonanagia wendani waku kũrĩ andũ ngiri na ngiri, no ũkaherithania nĩ ũndũ wa mehia ma maithe, ũkaũkinyĩria ciero-inĩ cia njiarwa ciao iria igooka thuutha wao. Wee Mũrungu mũnene na ũrĩ hinya, o wee rĩĩtwa rĩaku arĩ Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe,
english: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, Yahweh of Armies is your name:

kikuyu: Mũtiigana kũrĩa irio, kana mũkĩnyua ndibei kana kĩndũ kĩngĩ o gĩothe kĩgagatu. Ndeekire ũndũ ũcio nĩgeetha mũmenye atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu.
english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.

kikuyu: “Nĩndakũhe maguta mothe marĩa mega mũno ma mũtamaiyũ na ndibei yothe ĩrĩa njega mũno ya mũhihano, na ngano ĩrĩa maheaga Jehova ĩrĩ maciaro ma mbere ma magetha mao.
english: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Githĩ tiwe wahũithirie iria, maaĩ ma kũndũ kũrĩa kũriku mũno, o wee watemire njĩra kũu iria-inĩ kũrĩa kũriku, nĩgeetha andũ arĩa wakũũrĩte maringĩre yo?
english: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio Jesũ akiumĩrĩra andũ angĩ eerĩ ao, ahaana ũndũ ũngĩ, rĩrĩa maathiiaga mĩgũnda-inĩ.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

kikuyu: Akĩrĩgemia na thahabu therie thĩinĩ na nja, na akĩrĩtiriha na mũcibi wa thahabu mĩena yothe.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

kikuyu: Nao andũ othe nĩmakona ũhonokio wa Ngai.’ ”
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’ ”*

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, maũndũ marĩa mekagwo nĩ mwĩrĩ nĩmoĩo, namo nĩ: ũmaraya, na meciiria mooru, na ũmaramari,
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

kikuyu: “Angĩkorwo nĩũtengʼeranĩtie na andũ marathiĩ na magũrũ nao magakũhũmia-rĩ, wakĩhota atĩa gũcindana na mbarathi? Angĩkorwo nĩũhĩngagwo ũkĩgerera bũrũri ũrĩ thayũ-rĩ, ũgaakĩhota atĩa gũtũrĩkania ihinga iria irĩ hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Jorodani?
english: “If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

kikuyu: Hihi mūcehere mwega wa kahūa gūkū Kenya nī ūrīkū?
english: How to prune coffee in Kenya?

english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

kikuyu: Rehoboamu akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Thiĩi mũgaacooka kũrĩ niĩ thuutha wa mĩthenya ĩtatũ.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ magĩĩthiĩra.
english: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.

kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Mũtumia wa mũndũ angĩhĩngĩcania mĩthiĩre yake, atuĩke ti mwĩhokeku harĩ we
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

kikuyu: “Thondeka mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa ma thahabu therie, kĩrũgamo o na gĩtina kĩaguo iturwo inyiitanĩte; ikombe ciaguo ihaana ta mahũa, na tũkonyo twaguo o na mahũa ikorwo irĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe inyiitanĩte naguo.
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

kikuyu: “Ithuĩ tũtingĩthikĩrĩria ndũmĩrĩri ĩyo ũtwarĩirie ũkĩgwetaga rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova!
english: “As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.

kikuyu: No Mwathani akĩĩra Anania atĩrĩ, “Thiĩ, tondũ ũndũ ũcio nĩ kĩndũ gĩakwa kĩrĩa ndĩĩthuurĩire gĩa gũtwara ũhoro wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa kũrĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ, na athamaki, o na kũrĩ andũ a Isiraeli.
english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

kikuyu: “Nake nĩakamacookeria atĩrĩ, ‘Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, ũndũ o wothe mũteekire ũmwe wa aya anini mũno, nĩ niĩ mũteekĩire.’
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

kikuyu: Riũa rĩrathaga na rĩgathũa, ningĩ rĩgacooka na ihenya kũrĩa rĩrathagĩra.
english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, Jehova Ngai Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, Ngai wa Isiraeli, ekuuga atĩrĩ: ‘Ta thikĩrĩriai! Nĩngũrehithĩria Juda o na mũndũ wothe ũtũũraga Jerusalemu mwanangĩko ũrĩa wothe ndoigire nĩngamarehere. Niĩ ndaamaarĩirie, no-o makĩrega gũthikĩrĩria; ndaametire no-o makĩrega kũn- jĩtĩka.’ ”
english: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.’ ”

kikuyu: Akiuga atĩrĩ: “Jehova nĩokire kuuma Sinai, na akĩmathererũkĩra kuuma Seiru; akĩmaarĩra kuuma kĩrĩma gĩa Parani. Ookire na ikundi cia arĩa atheru kuuma gũthini, akiuma iharũrũka-inĩ cia irĩma ciake.
english: He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.†

kikuyu: Kwarĩ thaa ithatũ cia rũciinĩ rĩrĩa ciamwambire mũtĩ igũrũ.
english: It was the third hour† when they crucified him.

kikuyu: Na thuutha ũcio Mũthamaki Zedekia agĩtũmana areehwo kũu nyũmba-inĩ ya ũthamaki. Arĩ kũu, mũthamaki akĩmũũria na hitho atĩrĩ, “Hihi nĩ harĩ ndũmĩrĩri yumĩte kũrĩ Jehova?” Nake Jeremia akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ĩĩ, nĩ kũrĩ; wee nĩũkaneanwo moko-inĩ ma mũthamaki wa Babuloni.”
english: then Zedekiah the king sent and had him brought out. The king asked him secretly in his house, “Is there any word from Yahweh?” Jeremiah said, “There is.” He also said, “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”

kikuyu: ũkaamenyerera ndũkanariganĩrwo nĩ Jehova, ũrĩa wakũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri, agĩkũruta bũrũri wa ũkombo.
english: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: Mīharatī ya maaī nīkīī na īngīigīka īrī mītheru?
english: What are drinkers and how do you clean drinkers for chicken?

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo nĩ nyamũ ĩmwe ya iria irĩ thaahu, no amĩgũre na thogora ũrĩa ĩtuĩrĩirwo, ongerere gĩcunjĩ kĩngĩ gĩa ithano harĩ thogora ũcio. Aakorwo ndekũmĩkũũra, nyamũ ĩyo nĩĩkeendio na thogora ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

kikuyu: Ndĩ hakuhĩ gũtumũra kanua gakwa; ciugo ciakwa irĩ o rũrĩmĩ-inĩ rwakwa.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

kikuyu: Nake ndakanahikie atumia aingĩ, nĩguo ngoro yake ndĩkanagarũrũke. Ningĩ ndakaneingĩhĩrie betha na thahabu.
english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ a Isiraeli magĩteta nĩ ũndũ wa moritũ mao, nakuo gũteta kwao gũkĩiguuo nĩ Jehova, na rĩrĩa aamaiguire, agĩakanwo nĩ marakara, naguo mwaki ũkiuma kũrĩ Jehova, ũgĩakana gatagatĩ kao, na ũgĩcina ndeere imwe cia kambĩ.
english: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

kikuyu: Na mũndũ ũmwe warĩ na mangũ agĩũka kũrĩ we na akĩmũthaitha aturĩtie maru, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ũngĩenda-rĩ, no ũũtherie.”
english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Aaciigire handũ hacio itũũre ho tene na tene; aaheanire kĩrĩra kĩa watho wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo kĩrĩa gĩtagathira.
english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

kikuyu: “Nayo ndungata ya keerĩ ĩgĩũka, ĩkĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathi, mina yaku nĩyumithĩtie mina ingĩ ithano.’
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

kikuyu: Obili ũrĩa Mũishumaeli nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra ngamĩĩra. Jehedeia ũrĩa Mũmeronothu nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra ndigiri.
english: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

kikuyu: No nĩũkagĩa na mũriũ ũrĩa ũgaatuĩka mũndũ wa thayũ na wa kũhoorera, na nĩngamũhe ũhurũko kuuma kũrĩ thũ ciake mĩena yothe. Rĩĩtwa rĩake ageetwo Solomoni, na hĩndĩ ya ũthamaki wake nĩngaahe Isiraeli thayũ na ũhurũko.
english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

kikuyu: Igua gũthaithana kwa ndungata yaku na kwa andũ aku a Isiraeli rĩrĩa mekũhooya marorete handũ haha. Ũigue ũrĩ kũu igũrũ, o kũu gĩikaro gĩaku; na watũigua-rĩ, ũgatũrekera.
english: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa yothe itu rĩu rĩeheraga kuuma harĩ hema ĩyo, andũ a Isiraeli makoimagara magathiĩ; na rĩrĩ, itu rĩu rĩarũgamĩra handũ, andũ a Isiraeli makaamba hema ciao ho.
english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

kikuyu: Nĩũregaga arĩa othe matiganaga na kĩrĩra kĩa watho waku, nĩgũkorwo kwĩheenia kũu meheenagia nakuo nĩ gwa tũhũ.
english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

kikuyu: Andũ nĩ kũũra mooraga maigua mũrurumo wa mũgambo waku; warahũka-rĩ, ndũrĩrĩ nĩihurunjũkaga.
english: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, kwarĩ mũthenya wa Ihaarĩria wa Ayahudi, nĩguo marokere Thabatũ ya mwanya. Na tondũ Ayahudi matiendaga mĩĩrĩ ĩyo ĩtigwo mĩtharaba-inĩ hĩndĩ ya Thabatũ, makĩũria Pilato aathane atĩ andũ acio maambĩtwo moinwo magũrũ, na mĩĩrĩ yao ĩcuurũrio.
english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

english: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

english: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

kikuyu: Jakubu akĩmaka mũno na akĩnyamarĩka, akĩgayania andũ arĩa aarĩ nao ikundi igĩrĩ, o na ndũũru cia mbũri na ndũũru cia ngʼombe o na ngamĩĩra nacio.
english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.

english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

kikuyu: Nao andũ acio nĩmamakire maatwarwo gwake mũciĩ. Magĩĩciiria atĩrĩ, “Twarehwo gũkũ nĩ ũndũ wa betha iria ciacookirio makũnia-inĩ maitũ hĩndĩ ya mbere. Arenda gũtũtharĩkĩra atũtoorie na atũtue ngombo ciake, na oe ndigiri ciitũ.”
english: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

kikuyu: Nake mũrũ wa nyina ũrĩa warĩ na uthi mũtune guoko-inĩ gwake akiuma, nake agĩtuuo Zera. 39
english: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

kikuyu: Moima Pi-Hahirothu, magĩtuĩkanĩria iria-inĩ gatagatĩ, magĩkinya werũ-inĩ, na maarĩkia gũthiĩ rũgendo rwa mĩthenya ĩtatũ werũ-inĩ ũcio wa Ethamu, makĩamba hema ciao Mara.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

kikuyu: Ningĩ maithe maitũ marĩa ma tene maarĩ a kĩruka kĩu, nake Kristũ aarĩ wa rũciaro rwao ha ũhoro wa mwĩrĩ, o we Ngai ũrĩa wathaga maũndũ mothe, ũrĩa ũgoocagwo nginya tene! Ameni.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Wee Mũrungu, ngitagĩra, nĩgũkorwo nĩ harĩwe njũragĩra.
english: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Rĩra na ũgirĩke, wee mũrũ wa mũndũ, nĩgũkorwo nĩrũũkĩrĩire andũ akwa, o na rũgookĩrĩra athamaki othe a Isiraeli. Nĩmaneanĩtwo rũhiũ-inĩ rwa njora marĩ hamwe na andũ akwa. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio wĩhũũre gĩthũri.
english: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is on my people. It is on all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people. Therefore beat your thigh.

kikuyu: ītunda ria īrigu rīoyaga kahinda kaigana atīa gūkūra?
english: How long does a banana fruit take to mature?

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩakamuurĩria mbura nĩ ũndũ wa mbeũ iria mũhaandĩte mĩgũnda, nacio irio iria ikoima mĩgũnda ĩyo igaakorwo irĩ njega na ikaingĩha. Hĩndĩ ĩyo ngʼombe cianyu ikaarĩithagio kũndũ kũrĩ ũrĩithio mwariĩ mũno.
english: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

kikuyu: Ndĩrĩtaranagia mawĩra maku mothe, na ngecũũrania ũhoro wa ciĩko ciaku cia hinya.
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

kikuyu: Menyagĩrĩrai maathani ma Jehova Ngai wanyu, mũthiage na njĩra ciake na mũmwĩtigagĩre.
english: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

kikuyu: Ũtukũ ũmwe-rĩ, o ũmwe witũ akĩroota kĩroto, na o kĩroto kĩarĩ na ũtaũri wakĩo mwanya.
english: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.

kikuyu: Harũni nĩakaruta thenge ĩrĩa ĩkaagũĩrwo nĩ mũtĩ wa mwena wa Jehova, amĩrute ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia.
english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo mũgaakũũrania gĩcunjĩ kĩanyu gĩa ikũmi na betha, na inyuĩ mũtware betha ĩyo handũ harĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu agaathuura.
english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose.

kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Juda kũringana na mbarĩ ciao nĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Shela, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashela; kuuma kũrĩ Perezu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aperezu; kuuma kũrĩ Zera, nĩ mbarĩ ya Azera.
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

kikuyu: O nakuo Jerusalemu-rĩ, Jehoshafatu nĩathuurire Alawii amwe, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na atongoria a nyũmba cia andũ a Isiraeli marũgamagĩrĩre watho wa Jehova, na magatuithanagia maciira o na makaniina ngarari. Nao maatũũraga Jerusalemu.
english: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites, priests, and heads of the fathers’ households of Israel to give judgment for Yahweh and for controversies. They returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nao andũ acio makĩnjũũria atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ ũtangĩtwĩra ũhoro wa maũndũ maya na ũrĩa matũkoniĩ?”
english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”

kikuyu: Nao magooka makĩrĩraga; nĩmakahooyaga ngĩmacookia kwao. Nĩngamagereria ndwere-inĩ cia tũrũũĩ twa maaĩ, njĩra-inĩ ĩrĩa njaraganu kũndũ matangĩhĩngwo, nĩgũkorwo niĩ nĩ niĩ ithe wa Isiraeli, nake Efiraimu nĩwe mũrũ wakwa wa irigithathi.
english: They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they won’t stumble; for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jakubu akĩĩra andũ a nyũmba yake, na arĩa othe maarĩ nao, atĩrĩ, “Eheriai ngai cia mĩhianano iria mũrĩ nacio, na mwĩtherie inyuĩ ene, na mwĩkĩre nguo ingĩ.
english: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Solomoni aarĩkirie gwaka hekarũ ya Jehova o na nyũmba ya ũthamaki, na akĩhingia maũndũ marĩa mothe erirĩirie gwĩka-rĩ,
english: When Solomon had finished the building of Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

kikuyu: Maũndũ macio ũmekaga o ngirĩte, nawe ũgeciiria atĩ niĩ ndariĩ o tawe. No rĩrĩ, rĩu nĩngũkũrũithia, nguonie maũndũ marĩa wĩkĩte.
english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

kikuyu: Nake agĩthiĩ agĩĩka o ũguo Elija aamwĩrire. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio o mũthenya nĩ kwarĩ na irio cia Elija, na cia mũtumia ũcio na nyũmba yake.
english: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.

kikuyu: o na Gomeri na thigari ciakuo ciothe, o na andũ a Bethi Togarima moimĩte kũraya mwena wa gathigathini marĩ na mbũtũ cia ita ciakuo ciothe, o ndũrĩrĩ icio nyingĩ irĩ hamwe nawe.
english: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.

kikuyu: No ithuĩ-rĩ, tũkoragwo twĩhokete atĩ nĩtũgatuuo athingu. Ũndũ ũcio nĩguo tũkoragwo twĩrĩgĩrĩire tũrĩ na wĩtĩkio, tũhotithĩtio nĩ Roho.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

kikuyu: Wee nĩũthikagĩrĩria ndundu ya Ngai? Wee wiki-rĩ, nowe ũrigĩtie na ũũgĩ?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

kikuyu: Solomoni nĩ aarĩ na andũ 70,000 a gũkuua mĩrigo, na aicũhia a mahiga 80,000 kũu irĩma-inĩ,
english: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,

kikuyu: Nĩmakĩĩte kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru gwa kũhooerwo Baali, na gwa gũcinagĩrwo ariũ ao na mwaki matuĩke maruta ma kũrutĩrwo Baali, ũndũ ũrĩa niĩ itaathanire wĩkagwo, kana ngĩũgweta, o na ũndũ ũtarĩ wagĩa meciiria-inĩ makwa.
english: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.

kikuyu: Eberi aarĩ na ariũ eerĩ: Ũmwe eetagwo Pelegu, tondũ hĩndĩ yake nĩrĩo thĩ yagayũkanirio; na mũrũ wa nyina eetagwo Jokitani.
english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

kikuyu: Atwaragwo mbĩrĩra-inĩ, nayo mbĩrĩra yake ĩkarangagĩrwo.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

kikuyu: Makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, tũrakũhooya o tũcooke kuona.”
english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

kikuyu: Nĩngamũtũmĩra kĩrathimo mwaka-inĩ ũcio wa gatandatũ nĩguo mĩgũnda yanyu ĩgaaciara maciaro ma kũmũigana mĩaka ĩtatũ.
english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

kikuyu: agĩcooka agĩikara arĩ wa ndigwa na hĩndĩ ĩyo aarĩ na mĩaka mĩrongo ĩnana na ĩna. Nake ndoimaga hekarũ-inĩ, noaatũirekuoahooyagaNgaiũtukũnamũthenya, naakehiingagakũrĩairionaakahooyaga.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

kikuyu: O buremu yarĩ ya mĩkono ikũmi* kũraiha, na mũkono ũmwe na nuthu† kwarama,
english: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

kikuyu: Mwĩtĩĩo ũrũmagĩrĩrwo nĩ mwanangĩko, roho wa mwĩtũũgĩrio ũkarũmĩrĩrwo nĩ kũgũa.
english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

kikuyu: “Ndũkanacumĩkĩre nyũmba ya mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩ. Ndũkanacumĩkĩre mũtumia wa mũndũ ũngĩ, kana ũcumĩkĩre ndungata yake ya mũndũ mũrũme kana ya mũndũ-wa-nja, kana ndegwa yake kana ndigiri yake, o na kana kĩndũ gĩothe gĩake.”
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Petero onire ũguo, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Andũ aya a Isiraeli, ũndũ ũyũ ũramũgegia nĩkĩ? Mũratũrora atĩa taarĩ hinya witũ kana ũthingu witũ watũma mũndũ ũyũ etware na magũrũ?
english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa mũrĩteithagia atumia a Ahibirania makĩgĩa ciana, na mwamarora marĩ gĩtanda-inĩ gĩa kũgĩĩra mwana-rĩ, mũngĩona nĩ kahĩĩ kooragei, no kangĩkorwo karĩ kairĩtu, mũkareka gatũũre muoyo.”
english: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”

kikuyu: Filipu, o ta Petero na Anderea, aarĩ wa itũũra rĩa Bethisaida.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

kikuyu: Tũũgĩriai Jehova Ngai witũ, na mũmũinamĩrĩre, mũmũhooe mũrĩ gĩturwa-inĩ kĩa makinya make; we nĩwe mũtheru.
english: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

kikuyu: Nake akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Haha nĩho handũ harĩa athĩnjĩri-Ngai marĩrugagĩra iruta rĩa mahĩtia, na iruta rĩa mehia, na nĩho marĩĩhĩhagĩria iruta rĩa ngano, nĩgeetha matikanamoimie na kũu nja ya nyumĩrĩra, matigatherie andũ namo.”
english: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”

kikuyu: Ũtũmĩte andũ aku moke marume Jehova. Na ũkoiga atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩ ũndũ wa ngaari ciakwa nyingĩ cia ita, nĩnyambatĩte ngakinya tũcũmbĩrĩ twa irĩma, o kũu igũrũ mũno Lebanoni. Nĩndemete mĩtarakwa yakuo ĩrĩa mĩraihu mũno, o na mĩthengera ĩrĩa mĩega mũno. Nĩnginyĩte tũcũmbĩrĩ twakuo kũrĩa kũraya mũno, o kũrĩa kũrĩ na mĩtitũ ĩrĩa mĩega mũno.
english: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.

kikuyu: magĩtherera igũrũ wa irĩma, magĩikũrũka cianda-inĩ, magĩtherera na kũrĩa watuĩte mathiĩ.
english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

kikuyu: Athamaki othe makaamũinamĩrĩra, nacio ndũrĩrĩ ciothe imũtungatagĩre.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

kikuyu: Ũtukũ ndirikanaga rĩĩtwa rĩaku, ngakĩrũmia watho waku Wee Jehova.
english: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

kikuyu: K7 nīyagīraga kūndū kūrīa gūtarī igūrū mūno, īkoragwo na mīri mīega, īciaraga mūno noo nīīnyitagwo nī mīrimū raithi.
english: K7 suitable for low altitude area, has good rooting system, high yielder but susceptible to diseases.

kikuyu: Mūrimū wa Pulorum ūrehagwo nī njamuthi mūthemba wa Salmonella Pullorum, īria īrwaragia kīga kia matumbī ma ngūkū.
english: Pullorum disease is caused by a microorganism called Salmonella Pullorum, which infects the ovary of the hen

kikuyu: Wee ũhonokagia andũ arĩa enyiihia, no arĩa marĩ maitho ma mwĩtĩĩo ũkamaconorithia.
english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

kikuyu: akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ aambaga kũruta ndibei ĩrĩa njega, na ageni maarĩkia kũnyua mũno, agacooka akaruta ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ njega; no wee ũkũigĩte ĩrĩa njega nginya rĩu.”
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo inyuĩ, o na mũrĩ ooru, nĩmũũĩ kũhe ciana cianyu iheo njega-rĩ, Ithe wanyu ũrĩa ũrĩ Igũrũ githĩ ndarĩkĩragĩrĩria kũhe Roho Mũtheru kũrĩ arĩa mamũhooyaga!”
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

kikuyu: Nĩekire maũndũ mooru maitho-inĩ ma Jehova, o ta ũrĩa nyũmba ya Ahabu yekĩte, nĩgũkorwo thuutha wa gĩkuũ gĩa ithe, nĩo maatuĩkire amũtaari na makĩmũhĩtithia.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.

kikuyu: Bũthi wa bũrũri ndũkaririkanwo, tondũ ngʼaragu ĩrĩa ĩgacooka kũgĩa nĩĩgakorwo ĩrĩ nene mũno.
english: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

kikuyu: Handū hau habatiī gūītīkīria rīera gūcera wega, na kweheria rīera rīrīa rīūrū mūthemba wa ammonia na rūkūngū. Ndirica ciīkīrwo thingo-inī iroranīte. Wire mesh ya mita 0.6 īkīrwo mwena wa thutha, nakuo nambere īkirwo na wariī wa mita īmwe kana mita igīrī kūndū kūrīa kūrī na ūrūgarī.
english: Should have a good ventilation to allow fresh air circulation: get rid of excess ammonia and dust. Windows on either side. About 0.6m wire mesh at the back, 1m opening in front (2m in hot areas)

kikuyu: Ha ũhoro wa maũndũ marĩa mangĩ makoniĩ wathani wa Omuri, ũrĩa eekire na marĩa ahingirie- rĩ, githĩ matiandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa maũndũ ma athamaki a Isiraeli?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, ndaarĩkia kũnengera Baruku wa Neria marũa macio ma kĩrĩkanĩro gĩa kuonania nũũ mwene gĩthaka, ngĩhooya Jehova ngiuga ũũ:
english: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to Yahweh, saying,

kikuyu: Ũngĩgaakorerera gĩtara kĩa nyoni mũkĩra-inĩ wa njĩra, kĩrĩ mũtĩ igũrũ kana kĩrĩ thĩ, nayo nyoni ĩyo ĩkorwo ĩkomereirie tũcui twayo kana matumbĩ, ndũkanoe nyoni ĩyo na tũcui twayo.
english: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

kikuyu: Iria rĩrĩa inene nĩrĩkaiyũra Babuloni guothe; mũrurumo wa ndiihũ ciarĩo nĩguo ũgaakũhubanĩria.
english: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.

kikuyu: Anenehagia ndũrĩrĩ, agacooka agaciananga; aingĩhagia ndũrĩrĩ, agacooka agacihurunja.
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo kiugo kĩa Jehova gĩgĩkinyĩra Isaia, akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Isaiah, saying,

kikuyu: Aringi ciama a Misiri matingĩahotire kũrũgama mbere ya Musa nĩ ũndũ wa mahũha marĩa maarĩ namo,* hamwe na andũ othe a bũrũri wa Misiri.
english: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Moima Alushu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Refidimu, handũ hataarĩ na maaĩ ma kũnyuuo nĩ andũ.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

kikuyu: Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ngũkwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩtoonya ũthamaki-inĩ wa Ngai atangĩciarwo na maaĩ na Roho.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Indo icio ituĩke rwĩga rwa kũheagwo Harũni na ariũ ake nĩ andũ a Isiraeli hĩndĩ ciothe. Nĩrĩo iruta rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli marĩrutagĩra Jehova kuuma maruta-inĩ ma ũiguano.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.

english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

kikuyu: Gūthura handū hega ha gūthondeka natharī, no mūhaka ūrore maūndū maingī mamwe marīa ma bata meta ūnene wa mūgūnda, gūkūhīrīria maaī, tīīri, o na kūharūrūka kwa mūgūnda.
english: To select a suitable nursery site, many factors must be considered the most important being mother block, size, water, soil, slope and access.

kikuyu: Ciarĩkia kũmũnyũrũria, cikĩmũruta nguo ĩyo, na cikĩmũhumba nguo ciake mwene. Cigĩcooka cikĩmumagaria cikamwambe mũtĩ-igũrũ.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

kikuyu: Nao magĩkoma nake. O ta ũrĩa arũme makomaga na mũmaraya, ũguo nĩguo maakomire na andũ-a-nja acio maagĩte thoni, nao nĩo Ohola na Oholiba.
english: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya ũcio-rĩ, nĩngaahe Gogu handũ ha gũthikanwo kũu bũrũri-inĩ wa Isiraeli, gĩtuamba- inĩ kĩa agendi arĩa mathiiaga mwena wa irathĩro werekeire Iria rĩa Cumbĩ. Nao agendi magirĩrĩrio gũcooka kũgera njĩra ĩyo, tondũ Gogu na kĩrĩndĩ gĩake nĩkuo magaathikwo. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio hageetagwo Gĩtuamba kĩa Hamoni-Gogu.
english: “ ‘ “It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, nĩ ũndũ wa ũguo, mahĩtia ma Jakubu nĩmakahoroherio mathire, namo maciaro maya nĩmo makoonekana nĩ ũndũ wa kwehererio mehia make: Atĩ mahiga mothe ma kĩgongona akaamatua ta coka ũhehenjetwo ũgatuĩka tũcunjĩ, na gũtirĩ itugĩ cia Ashera kana igongona cia gũcinĩra ũbumba igaatigwo irũgamĩte.
english: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jehova Ngai akĩũmba mũndũ-wa-nja kuuma rũbaru rũrĩa aarutĩte kũrĩ mũndũ ũcio na akĩrehe mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio kũrĩ we.
english: Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

kikuyu: Eheriai ũrĩa ũhaandaga kũu Babuloni, na ũrĩa ũgethaga na rũhiũ rwake hĩndĩ ya magetha. Tondũ wa rũhiũ rũu rwa njora rwa mũhinyanĩrĩria-rĩ, o mũndũ nĩacooke kũrĩ andũ ao, o mũndũ nĩorĩre bũrũri wao kĩũmbe.
english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the oppressing sword, they will each return to their own people, and they will each flee to their own land.

kikuyu: Nīwega gūkamīra ng'ombe thīinī wa mūthaigū nīguo kūrigīrīria nyondo kūgīa na nguraro o na gūtambia njamuthi kuuma kūrī ng’ombe imwe nginya īrīa īngī.
english: By using proper milking technique in the parlor to prevent teat injury and cow-to-cow transmission of pathogens.

kikuyu: Nayo nda ĩrĩa yamaciarire ĩkariganĩrwo nĩo, igunyũ nacio ikamarĩa; andũ arĩa aaganu maticookaga kũririkanwo, no moinangagwo ta mũtĩ.
english: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

kikuyu: “Gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũũĩ ũhoro wa mũthenya ũcio kana ithaa rĩu, o na araika a igũrũ matiũĩ, o na Mũriũ ndooĩ, tiga Ithe wiki!
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngũthiĩ kũrĩ atongoria ngaaranĩrie nao; ti-itherũ acio nĩmoĩ njĩra ya Jehova, na makamenya ũrĩa Ngai wao endaga.” No rĩrĩ, othe marĩ hamwe, nĩmoinangĩte icooki rĩao rĩa ngingo, na magatua mĩkwa.
english: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

kikuyu: Nao andũ othe a itũũra makĩiyũrwo nĩ guoya, makaaragia ũhoro wa maũndũ macio mothe, namo makĩhunja bũrũri-inĩ ũcio wothe wa irĩma wa Judea.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩcooka agĩaka Tadimori kũu werũ-inĩ na matũũra manene mothe marĩa aakĩte kũu Hamathu ma kũigwo indo.
english: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

kikuyu: gĩkĩgĩa gatagatĩ ga thigari cia Misiri na cia Isiraeli. Ũtukũ wothe itu rĩu rĩgĩĩkĩra nduma mwena ũmwe, na ũtheri mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ; nĩ ũndũ ũcio gũtirĩ andũ makuhĩrĩirie arĩa angĩ ũtukũ wothe.
english: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.

kikuyu: “Oya mũcibi ũcio ũraagũrire, o ũcio wĩohete njohero, ũũkĩre o rĩu ũthiĩ ũkinye Rũũĩ rwa Farati, ũũhithe mwatũka-inĩ wa rwaro rwa ihiga.”
english: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”

kikuyu: Nao arutwo ake magĩũka kũrĩ we, makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Waragĩria andũ na ngerekano nĩkĩ?”
english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

kikuyu: Nao Afarisai amwe makiuga atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũyũ ndoimĩte kũrĩ Ngai, nĩgũkorwo ndamenyagĩrĩra Thabatũ.” No arĩa angĩ makĩũria atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ mwĩhia ahota atĩa kũringa ciama ta ici?” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩamũkana.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

kikuyu: “Mwĩtĩĩi ũcio nĩakahĩngwo agwe, na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũkaamũũkĩria; nĩngagwatia matũũra makuo mwaki, naguo nĩũgaacina arĩa othe mamũrigiicĩirie, maniinwo biũ.”
english: The proud one will stumble and fall, and no one will raise him up. I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all who are around him.”

kikuyu: Jehoiada mũrũ wa Benaia na Abiatharu nĩo maacookire ithenya rĩa Ahithofeli. Joabu nĩwe warĩ mũnene wa mbũtũ cia ita cia mũthamaki.
english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

kikuyu: andũ arĩa Jehova arathimĩte nĩmakagaya bũrũri, no arĩa arumĩte nĩmakaniinwo.
english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ, Wee wendaga ũhoro wa ma kuuma ngoro thĩinĩ; nĩ ũndũ ũcio ũndutaga kũgĩa na ũũgĩ ngoro-inĩ yakwa.
english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

kikuyu: Mūcamo mwega mūno;
english: Great taste;

kikuyu: Ndakanahikie mũtumia wa ndigwa, kana mũtumia matiganĩte na mũthuuriwe, kana mũndũ-wa-nja wĩthaahĩtie na ũmaraya, no akaahikia mũirĩtu gathirange wa andũ ao,
english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

kikuyu: Marĩ handũ harĩa mararĩrĩire marĩ rũgendo-inĩ-rĩ, Jehova akiumĩrĩra Musa, na aarĩ hakuhĩ kũmũũraga.
english: On the way at a lodging place, Yahweh met Moses and wanted to kill him.

kikuyu: Acio nĩo andũ arĩa maathuurirwo kuuma kũrĩ kĩrĩndĩ gĩa Isiraeli, marĩ atongoria a mĩhĩrĩga ya maithe mao ma tene. Nĩo maarĩ atongoria a mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes‡ of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

kikuyu: Mũrungu ũrĩa ũtũũrĩte aikarĩire gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene nginya tene, nĩekũmaigua na amaherithie, andũ acio matagarũragĩra mĩthiĩre yao, o acio matetigagĩra Ngai.
english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

kikuyu: Andũ aingĩ a arĩa meetĩkirie makĩyumĩria na makiumbũra waganu wao matekũhitha.
english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

kikuyu: Na Gĩathĩ kĩu gĩathira, rĩrĩa aciari ake mainũkaga-rĩ, kamwana kau ti Jesũ, gagĩtigwo na thuutha kũu Jerusalemu, no matiamenyire.
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

kikuyu: “ ‘Mwĩyamũrei mũtuĩke atheru tondũ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu.
english: “ ‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Yahweh your God.

kikuyu: Mũhĩrĩga wa Nafitali nĩguo ũgũcookerera. Mũtongoria wa andũ a Nafitali nĩ Ahira mũrũ wa Enani.
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

kikuyu: na nĩo ithuĩ, ithuĩ arĩa eetire, na to arĩa moimĩte kũrĩ Ayahudi, no nĩ kuuma o na kũrĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ?
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

english: Is east coast fever vaccinations necessary to protect dairy cows and how often should they be administered?

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Paũlũ eetirwo thĩinĩ, Teritulo akĩambĩrĩria kũmũthitanga mbere ya Felike, akiuga atĩrĩ: “Nĩtũkeneire ihinda iraaya rĩa thayũ tũrĩ rungu rwaku, na ũũgĩ waku wa kuona na kabere nĩũgarũrĩte maũndũ marĩa mooru magatuĩka mega bũrũri-inĩ ũyũ.

kikuyu: o inyuĩ mũrũgamĩte haha na ithuĩ ũmũthĩ mbere ya Jehova Ngai witũ, no nĩ hamwe na arĩa matarĩ haha ũmũthĩ.
english: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, rĩrĩa ndaremirwo nĩgũkirĩrĩria rĩngĩ-rĩ, ngĩtũmana nĩguo menye ũhoro wa wĩtĩkio wanyu. Nĩgũkorwo nĩndetigagĩra gũtigakorwo atĩ hihi mũgerania nĩamũgeretie, naguo wĩra witũ ũtuĩke wa tũhũ.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

kikuyu: Ngoro yakwa ĩringĩkaga nĩ kwĩrirĩria ũhonokio waku, no niĩ njigĩte mwĩhoko wakwa harĩ kiugo gĩaku.
english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa rũhuho rwa gathigathini rũrehaga mbura, noguo rũrĩmĩ rwa njuukũ rũrehaga ũhoro wa marakara.
english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũkoona ũndũ ũcio, ngoro cianyu nĩigakena, nawe ũrirũke ta nyeki nduru; naguo hinya wa guoko kwa Jehova nĩũkamenyeka nĩ ndungata ciake, no marakara make nĩmakamenyeka nĩ thũ ciake.
english: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. Yahweh’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

english: Fuerte is one of the major varieties in export markets.

kikuyu: ‘Nĩtwaribariba o na rũkũngũ rwa itũũra rĩanyu rũrĩa rwĩnyiitĩrĩire magũrũ maitũ, rũmũcookerere. No rĩrĩ, menyai wega ũũ: ũthamaki wa Ngai nĩũmũkuhĩrĩirie.’
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

english: Reduced Yield and Quality: Green coffee cherries have not reached full maturity, meaning they haven't developed their full flavor potential.

english: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

english: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.

english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

english: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.” ’ ”

kikuyu: Maaĩ ma Dimoni maiyũrĩtwo nĩ thakame, no nĩngũrehe maũndũ mangĩ mooru makĩria kũu Dimoni, mahaana ta mũrũũthi ũgũtharĩkĩra andũ arĩa morĩte kuuma Moabi, o na ũtharĩkĩre arĩa matigaire kũu bũrũri-inĩ.
english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.

kikuyu: Nakĩo kĩndũ gĩa kũnyuuo kĩrĩa kĩrĩrutanagĩrio na igongona rĩu kĩrĩkoragwo kĩrĩ gĩcunjĩ gĩa kana kĩa hini ĩmwe‡ ya ndibei ngagatu harĩ o gatũrũme kamwe. Itagĩrai Jehova iruta rĩu rĩa kũnyuuo handũ-harĩa-haamũre.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin§ for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

kikuyu: Rungu rwa wariĩ ũcio, mathagu ma cio maatambũrũkĩtio o rĩmwe rĩerekeire harĩ rĩrĩa rĩngĩ, na o kĩũmbe kĩarĩ na mathagu meerĩ marĩa maakĩhumbĩrĩte mwĩrĩ.
english: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

kikuyu: O mũndũ nĩakoya rũgĩo rwake na arwĩkĩre ũbumba, ngĩo ciothe nĩ 250, na mũcirehe mbere ya Jehova. Wee, na Harũni, o na inyuĩ mũrehe ngĩo cianyu.”
english: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Kũngĩkorwo arĩa mataagĩrĩirwo kũnyuĩra gĩkombe kĩu no nginya makĩnyuĩre-rĩ, wee ũngĩkĩaga kũherithio nĩkĩ? Ndũrĩ hĩndĩ ũtakaherithio, no rĩrĩ, no nginya ũgaakĩnyuĩra.”
english: For Yahweh says: “Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup will certainly drink; and are you he who will altogether go unpunished? You won’t go unpunished, but you will surely drink.

english: To control fungal diseases on seed tubers, they should be dipped in a solution containing 2 to 3 g fungicide/L of water prior to any sunlight treatment;

kikuyu: “Atĩrĩrĩ, nĩngamũrehithĩria nyoka irĩ thumu gatagatĩ kanyu, ndĩmũrehithĩrie nduĩra iria itangĩhoorereka, nacio nĩikamũrũma,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: na ũthondeke mbaũ igĩrĩ cia koine cia mwena wa na thuutha.
english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

kikuyu: Nĩagathĩnjĩragatũrũme kau handũ harĩa hatheru, harĩa iruta rĩa kũhoroheriomehia na iruta rĩa njino ithĩnjagĩrwo. O ta ũrĩa iruta rĩa kũhoroherio mehia rĩrĩ rĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai-rĩ, no taguo iruta rĩa mahĩtia rĩrĩ rĩake, rĩu nĩ iruta itheru mũno makĩria.
english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo ũthamaki nĩ wa Jehova, na nĩwe wathaga ndũrĩrĩ ciothe.
english: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo o ta ũrĩa ũremi wa mũndũ ũmwe watũmire andũ aingĩ matuuo ehia-rĩ, ũguo noguo gwathĩka kwa mũndũ ũcio ũmwe gũgũtũma andũ aingĩ matuuo athingu.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

kikuyu: Kĩmakania gĩoka-rĩ, magaacaragia thayũ, no ndũkooneka.
english: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmahe kĩrĩa maamwĩtirie, no akĩmatũmĩra mũrimũ wa kũmanyariira.
english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maarĩ o anini magĩtarwo, o anini biũ, na maarĩ ageni kuo-rĩ,
english: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

kikuyu: Kūgūmīrwo nīūme gūcūngagīrīra gwīkūja na gūthūka kwa mathagū namo maumīrīra nī ciongo ciīkūnjite ūūru
english: Aphid attack results in curled and distorted leaves which in turn leads to poor head formation.

kikuyu: Andũ othe nĩmaiguĩte ngumo ya wathĩki wanyu, nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩnjiyũrĩtwo nĩ gĩkeno nĩ ũndũ wanyu; no nĩngwenda mũgĩe na ũũgĩ harĩ maũndũ marĩa mega, na mwage ũcuuke harĩ maũndũ marĩa mooru.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

kikuyu: Kīaga gīite mahuti gīa kūrīithia ngūkū nyingī kiagīrīire gūikara kīrī kīniaru hingo ciothe.
english: The deep litter system should always kept dry.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo mũthuuri nĩwe mũtwe wa mũtumia o ta ũrĩa Kristũ nake arĩ we mũtwe wa kanitha, o guo mwĩrĩ wake, na nowe Mũhonokia waguo.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Ketura, ũrĩa warĩ thuriya ya Iburahĩmu, maarĩ: Zimirani, na Jokishani, na Medani, na Midiani, na Ishibaku, na Shua. Ariũ a Jokishani maarĩ: Sheba na Dedani.
english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: na Simoni ũrĩa Mũzelote, na Judasi Mũisikariota, ũrĩa wamũkunyanĩire.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

kikuyu: Kũu Dameski, barũthi ũrĩa waathanaga arĩ rungu rwa Mũthamaki Areta-rĩ, nĩathanire itũũra inene rĩa andũ a Dameski rĩrangĩrwo nĩgeetha aanyiitithie.
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

kikuyu: Agĩkĩhe mũthamaki taranda igana rĩa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ,* cia thahabu, na mahuti marĩa manungi wega maingĩ mũno, na tũhiga twa goro. Gũtirĩ hĩndĩ ĩngĩ kũrĩ kwarehwo mahuti manungi wega ta marĩa Mũthamaki mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio wa Sheba aaheire Mũthamaki Solomoni.
english: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

kikuyu: Mūtī wa sabre ndūnenehaga mūno na nī wītiragia mīrīmū wega.
english: The tree is medium size and fairly resistant to diseases.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa andũ aingĩ maagegirio mũno nĩ ũndũ wake, tondũ gĩthiithi gĩake nĩgĩathũkĩtio mũno, gĩgakĩra kĩa mũndũ o wothe, na mũhianĩre wake ũgathũkio gũkĩra mũhianĩre wa andũ,
english: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—

kikuyu: “Ũũ nĩguo Senakeribu mũthamaki wa Ashuri ekuuga: Mũrutĩte ũmĩrĩru wanyu kũ, nĩguo mũikare Jerusalemu, kũndũ gũthiũrũrũkĩrie?
english: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, rĩrĩa mwene mũgũnda ũcio wa mĩthabibũ agooka-rĩ, ageeka akombori acio atĩa?”
english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

kikuyu: O na ningĩ ndaimono ikiuma andũ aingĩ, ikĩanagĩrĩra atĩrĩ, “Wee nĩwe Mũrũ wa Ngai!” Nowe agĩcikaania na agĩcigiria ciarie, tondũ nĩcioĩ atĩ nĩwe Kristũ.
english: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

kikuyu: Akĩĩhĩta, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Kĩrĩa gĩothe ũngĩhooya nĩngũkũhe, o na angĩkorwo nĩ nuthu ya ũthamaki wakwa.”
english: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

kikuyu: Ndarĩ mũndũ o na ũmwe eetĩkĩririe amanyariire; nĩ ũndũ wao akĩrũithia athamaki, akĩmeera atĩrĩ:
english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

kikuyu: Tũũgĩriai Jehova Ngai witũ, na mũmũhooyage mũrĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩake kĩamũre, nĩgũkorwo Jehova Ngai witũ nĩ mũtheru.
english: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa kwaga thoni ciothe-rĩ, nĩmeheanĩte kũrĩ thuti cia ũũra-thoni magekaga mawaganu ma mĩthemba yothe, na magathiĩ na mbere kwĩrirĩria mangĩ maingĩ.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

kikuyu: Maathani maya mothe ndĩramũhe ũmũthĩ ma kũrũmĩrĩra mamenyagĩrĩrei nĩgeetha mũtũũre, na mũingĩhe, na mũtoonye mwĩgwatĩre bũrũri ũrĩa Jehova erĩire maithe manyu ma tene na mwĩhĩtwa.
english: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa njiarwa iria igooka, rĩrĩa rĩothe mũgeni kana mũndũ ũngĩ o wothe ũtũũranĩtie na inyuĩ arĩĩrutaga iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki rĩrĩ mũtararĩko wa gũkenia Jehova-rĩ, no nginya ekage o ta ũrĩa inyuĩ mwĩkaga.
english: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, as you do, so he shall do.

kikuyu: Mūthemba ūyū wa kahūa ka Ruiru 11 nīūkūraga narua ūkīringithanio na mīthemba īyo īngī tondū ūrūtaga maciaro ma mbere thutha wa kahinda ka mīaka īrī.
english: Compared with other varieties, which are more slow-growing, Ruiru 11 generally produces its first harvest within two years of planting.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa ũhoro ũcio wao- rĩ, andũ othe a Juda arĩa maatahirwo na rĩu marĩ Babuloni nĩmakamoinaga thimo makĩrumana, makoiga atĩrĩ, ‘Jehova arotũma ũtuĩke ta Zedekia na Ahabu, arĩa mũthamaki wa Babuloni aacinire na mwaki.’
english: A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘Yahweh make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;’

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai magĩĩka o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Rutaga wĩra waku wothe mĩthenya ĩtandatũ,
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

kikuyu: “ ‘Na rĩrĩ, mũhaka wanyu wa mwena wa irathĩro, ũkoima Hazoru-Enani ũkinye Shefamu.
english: “ ‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ũthondeke ngathĩka mĩrongo ĩtano cia thahabu, na ũcihũthĩre na kuohithania itambaya icio cia gũcuurio nĩguo hema ĩyo nyamũre ĩtuĩke kĩndũ kĩmwe.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

kikuyu: Macio nĩmo maathani marĩa Jehova aarĩirie ũngano wanyu wothe na mũgambo mũnene kĩrĩma- inĩ kĩu arĩ thĩinĩ wa mwaki, o na itu-inĩ, o na nduma ndumanu; na ndoongereire ũndũ ũngĩ. Agĩcooka akĩmaandĩka ihengere-inĩ igĩrĩ cia mahiga, akĩĩnengera.
english: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

kikuyu: Nī kūongagīrīra maciaro
english: Improve yield

kikuyu: Rehe ariũ ake na ũmahumbe kanjũ,
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

kikuyu: Tondũ wa marakara ma Jehova, bũrũri ũcio ndũgacooka gũtũũrwo nĩ andũ, no rĩrĩ, nĩgũkira gũgaakira ihooru biũ. Andũ arĩa othe makaagerera kũu Babuloni nĩmakamaka, na manyũrũrie kũndũ kũu tondũ wa ũrĩa gũgaakorwo kwanangĩtwo.
english: Because of Yahweh’s wrath she won’t be inhabited, but she will be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon will be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

kikuyu: “Kũrĩ andũ eerĩ maarĩ na thiirĩ wa mũndũ wakombithanagia mbeeca. Ũmwe aarĩ na thiirĩ wa dinari magana matano, na ũrĩa ũngĩ dinari mĩrongo ĩtano.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

kikuyu: Nao Musa na Harũni magĩthiĩ hau mbere ya Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo,
english: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Irĩma igĩtũhatũũha ta ndũrũme, natuo tũrĩma tũgĩtũhatũũha ta tũgondu.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, Jehova arĩ na njamba ĩrĩ hinya na ũhoti.† Ĩhaana ta mbura ya mbembe, na ta rũhuho rũrĩa rwanangaga, kana rũhuho rũnene rũrĩa rũniinanaga, o na kana mũiyũro wa mbura nene, nake nĩakarĩtungumania thĩ na hinya.
english: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

kikuyu: Mworagire ũrĩa mũheani wa muoyo, no Ngai nĩamũriũkirie kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ. Ithuĩ tũrĩ aira a ũhoro ũcio.
english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

kikuyu: Amerari (Alawii arĩa angĩ) maagaĩirwo matũũra maya: Kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Zebuluni makĩheo Jokineamu, na Karita, na Rimono, na Taboru, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo;
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Njīra cia kūrīma kahūa nī irīku?
english: What are the methods of cultivation of coffee?

kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio mũriũ wa mũtumia ũcio mwene mũciĩ akĩrwara. Nake akĩĩhĩrwo mũno makĩria, nginya agĩtiga kũhihia.
english: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Ladani, arĩa maarĩ Agerishoni na ũndũ wa Ladani, na maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia Ladani ũcio Mũgerishoni, maarĩ: Jehieli,
english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

kikuyu: Mũkaarĩhĩhĩria na mũrĩrĩĩre handũ hau Jehova Ngai wanyu agaathuura. Ningĩ kwarooka gũkĩa mũcooke hema- inĩ cianyu.
english: You shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahweh your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Nafitali maarĩ: Jahazieli, na Guni, na Jezeri, na Shalumu; aya maarĩ a rũciaro rwa Biliha.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

kikuyu: Kahūa kagethagwo maita maigana būrūri-ini wa kenya?
english: How many times is coffee harvested in a year in Kenya?

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa athĩnjĩri- Ngai arĩa anene na arutani a watho moonire maũndũ ma magegania marĩa eekaga, na maigua ũrĩa ciana cianagĩrĩra kũu hekarũ-inĩ ikiugaga atĩrĩ, “Hosana Mũrũ wa Daudi,” makĩrakara.
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

kikuyu: Nĩmwarutirwo, ũhoro ũkoniĩ mũtũũrĩre wanyu wa mbere, nĩgeetha mwĩaũre mũndũ wanyu ũrĩa wa tene, ũrĩa rĩu ũthũkĩtio nĩ merirĩria maguo ma maheeni;
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

kikuyu: Othe nĩmabatithirio matuĩke andũ a Musa marĩ rungu rwa itu rĩu, o na marĩ iria-inĩ rĩu.
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

kikuyu: Nake akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Mũrĩ na mĩgate ĩigana? Thiĩi mũrore.” Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maarorire makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Harĩ na mĩgate ĩtano, na thamaki igĩrĩ.”
english: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

kikuyu: Nĩndĩmwandĩkĩire marũa-inĩ makwa ngamwĩra mũtigage kũgĩaga thiritũ na andũ arĩa ahũũri maraya,
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

kikuyu: Nĩũmenete ũrutani wakwa, na ũgateanĩria ciugo ciakwa.
english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

kikuyu: īno nī njīra itarī goro mūnene na īhonokagia mahinda.
english: This method is cost effective and saves time.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũcio ahaana ta mũtĩ mũhaande tũmĩtaro-inĩ twa maaĩ, naguo ũciaraga maciaro maguo hĩndĩ ya mo yakinya, namo mathangũ maguo matihoohaga. Na rĩrĩ, ũndũ o wothe ekaga nĩũgaacagĩra.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

kikuyu: Wakĩagire kũiga mbeeca ciakwa bengi nĩkĩ, nĩgeetha rĩrĩa ngaacooka ndĩcioye irĩ na uumithio?’
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

kikuyu: Nī moritū marīkū monekaga kaingī tuta-inī
english: • Common problem at the nursery stage

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩahonetie andũ aingĩ, nĩ ũndũ ũcio arĩa maarĩ na mĩrimũ nĩmatindĩkanaga nĩguo mamũhutie.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

kikuyu: No nginya acine nguo ĩyo, kana ndigi icio njogothe, kana taama ũcio mũtume na guoya wa ngʼondu kana gatani, kana kĩndũ kĩngĩ gĩothe kĩa rũũa rũrĩa rũgwatie ũgumu ũcio, nĩ ũndũ ũgumu ũcio nĩ wa kwananga; kĩndũ kĩu no nginya gĩcinwo.
english: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa ngaakwarĩria-rĩ, nĩngakũhingũra kanua, nawe nĩũkameera ũũ, ‘Mwathani Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ.’ Ũrĩa wothe ũngĩthikĩrĩria nĩathikĩrĩrie, nake ũrĩa wothe ũkũrega nĩarege; nĩgũkorwo o nĩ andũ a nyũmba ya ũremi.
english: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”

kikuyu: “Andũ a kũngĩ nĩo magaacookereria thingo ciaku, nao athamaki ao magũtungatagĩre. O na akorwo nĩndakũhũũrire na marakara-rĩ, nĩũgeetĩkĩrĩka nĩ niĩ nĩguo ngũiguĩre tha.
english: “Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.

kikuyu: mũrũ wa Methusela, mũrũ wa Enoku, mũrũ wa Jaredi, mũrũ wa Mahalaleli, mũrũ wa Kenani,
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

kikuyu: na kĩgongona kĩa iruta rĩa njino hamwe na gĩtara gĩakĩo gĩa gĩcango, na mĩtĩ yakĩo, na indo ciakĩo ciothe; na kĩraĩ gĩa gĩcango na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo;
english: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

kikuyu: Ũkoiga atĩa rĩrĩa Jehova akaanenehia andũ arĩa watuĩte athiritũ aku nĩguo matuĩke a gũgwathaga? Githĩ ndũkanyiitwo nĩ ruo rũnene, ta rwa mũndũ-wa-nja akĩrũmwo?
english: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Tondũ nĩmũregete gũthikĩrĩria ndũmĩrĩri yakwa,
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,

kikuyu: mũmĩtui ndangĩmĩiyũria hĩ-inĩ ciake, o na kana ũrĩa ũmĩũnganagia amĩiyũrie moko-inĩ make.
english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũcio ndaaririe etaarĩte we mwene, no aarathire ũguo arĩ ta mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai mũnene wa mwaka ũcio, atĩ Jesũ nĩagakuĩra rũrĩrĩ rwa Ayahudi,
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

kikuyu: Maaĩ nĩmakuonire, Wee Ngai, maaĩ macio maakuonire makĩigua guoya, nakuo kũrĩa kũriku mũno gũkĩĩnyogonda.
english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

kikuyu: Na rĩu tũkũhooya Ngai atĩ mũtikae gwĩka ũndũ o na ũmwe mũũru. Ti atĩ nĩguo andũ monage atĩ nĩtwĩtĩkĩrĩtwo nĩwe, na nĩtũtooranĩtie, no nĩgeetha inyuĩ mwĩkage maũndũ marĩa magĩrĩire, o na tũngĩoneka ta tũtatooranĩtie.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

kikuyu: Na o akĩmarathimaga, akĩmatiga, akĩiyũkio akĩambata igũrũ.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

kikuyu: o we ũcio ũroraga thĩ, nayo ĩkainaina, o we ũhutagia irĩma, nacio ikoima ndogo.
english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

kikuyu: Nao atũmwo maacooka, makĩĩra Jesũ maũndũ marĩa mekĩte. Nake akĩehera kuo, agĩthiĩ nao itũũra rĩetagwo Bethisaida,
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of‡ a city called Bethsaida.

kikuyu: “Nowe Iburahĩmu akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, ‘Mũrũ wakwa, ririkana rĩrĩa watũire muoyo woonaga o maũndũ mega, hĩndĩ ĩyo Lazaro nake oonaga o maũndũ mooru, no rĩu we nĩmũnyamarũre, nawe ũrĩ ruo-inĩ.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
